#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pin the manually prepared GPT/overlay instance for identity-owner adoption.
# No format, member changes, start, credentials, grants or identity-store writes.
set -euo pipefail
fail() { printf 'prepare-chatbot-adoption: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $# == 1 && $1 =~ ^(3tchedCtlChatbot|3tchedChatbot|ID-[1-9][0-9]*)$ && ${#1} -le 63 && $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'usage (host root): prepare-chatbot-adoption NAME (existing configured chatbot)'
umask 077
name=$1

sid=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
key=[REDACTED:opaque-base64]
operator=${OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION-414fbc56-03fb-20ab-758a-bcc7a7cbdc0e}
client=${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs}
control_mount=${OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT:-/run/mounts/3tchedFS}
# --expected-session checks the existing mounted caller; it does not inject an
# identity or use a different principal when admission fails.
[[ -x $client && $operator =~ ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$ ]] || fail 'mounted client or canonical expected caller session absent'
command -v timeout >/dev/null || fail 'timeout is required for bounded preflight'
pool=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool
disk=$pool/.provisioning/$name.json
container=$pool/.provisioning/$name.incus.json
plans=/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-provision-plans
[[ -f $disk && ! -L $disk && -f $container && ! -L $container ]] || fail 'operator preparation receipts absent'
exec 9>"$pool/.provisioning/$name.lock"
flock -n 9 || fail 'instance preparation active'
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg image "$pool/$name.img" '
    .name==$name and .image==$image and .filesystem_prepared==true and
    .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1"
' "$disk" >/dev/null || fail 'disk preparation incomplete'
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" \
    --arg root "/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots/containers/$name/rootfs" \
    --arg view "$pool/.mounts/$name/root-view" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and .phase=="root-bound" and
    .root_bound==true and .upgrade_paired==true and .root_view_readonly==true and .identity_registered==false and
    .threetched_root==$root and .root_view==$view and .instance.name==$name and .instance.type=="container" and
    .instance.config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .instance.config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    (.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))
' "$container" >/dev/null || fail 'configured chatbot root binding differs or is already adopted'
native_uuid=$(jq -er '.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]' "$container")
if [[ ! -e $plans && ! -L $plans ]]; then mkdir -m 0700 "$plans"; fi
[[ $(realpath -e "$plans") == "$plans" && $(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$plans") == 0:0:700 ]] || fail 'unsafe private plan directory'
[[ ! -e $plans/$sid.json && ! -L $plans/$sid.json ]] || fail 'existing plan must be reconciled; never overwrite it'
work=$(mktemp -d "$pool/.provisioning/$name.adoption.XXXXXX")
printf 'Private preparation evidence: %s\n' "$work"
args=$(jq -cn --arg key "$key" '{wireguard_pubkey:$key}')
if ! timeout --kill-after=5s 30s "$client" invoke --mount "$control_mount" --expected-session "$operator" --args "$args" \
    plugins/identity_sled/operations/inspect_provision_preflight/call > "$work/preflight-receipt.json" \
    2> "$work/preflight-diagnostic"; then
    cat "$work/preflight-diagnostic" >&2
    fail 'owner preflight failed; retain evidence and do not retry through another identity or transport'
fi
# Keep only revision/native metadata; no SID1 is read or copied.
# V4 accepts only a fresh key or the exact explicit-deletion tombstone, as
# validated by identity_clean_provision.rs. Existing bound identities stay out.
jq -ce --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" '
    select(.plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.success==true and .plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.session_id==$sid and .wireguard_pubkey==$key) |
    select(.previous_instance==null and .previous_native_instance==null and .previous_instance_etag=="") |
    select((.expected_revision==0 and .expected_revision_operation_id=="") or
        ((.expected_revision|type)=="number" and .expected_revision>1 and
         .expected_revision<=9007199254740991 and .expected_revision==(.expected_revision|floor) and
         .expected_revision_operation_id==("delete-provision-"+$sid+"-"+((.expected_revision-1)|tostring)))) |
    {expected_revision,expected_revision_operation_id,previous_instance,previous_instance_etag}
' "$work/preflight-receipt.json" > "$work/preflight.json" || fail 'owner did not admit a fresh key or exact explicit-deletion preflight'
socket=/var/lib/incus/unix.socket
curl --silent --show-error --fail --noproxy '*' --max-time 30 --unix-socket "$socket" \
    --dump-header "$work/instance.headers" --output "$work/instance-response.json" \
    "http://unix.socket/1.0/instances/$name"
jq -ce --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" '
    select(.type=="sync" and .status_code==200)|.metadata|
    select(.name==$name and .type=="container" and .status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102 and
        .config["volatile.uuid"]==$uuid and .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and
        .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key)' \
    "$work/instance-response.json" > "$work/instance.json" || fail 'stopped Incus definition absent'
etag=$(awk 'tolower($1)=="etag:" {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); sub(/\r$/, ""); print}' "$work/instance.headers")
[[ -n $etag && $etag != *$'\n'* ]] || fail 'ambiguous Incus ETag'
timeout --kill-after=5s 30s incus --force-local --project default query /1.0/storage-pools/identity-roots > "$work/pool.json"
root=$(jq -er .root_mount "$disk")
[[ $root == "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" && $(findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs ]] || fail 'prepared root mount absent'
members='{}'
for member in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
    show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$root/$member")
    id=$(awk '$1=="Subvolume" && $2=="ID:" {print $3}' <<<"$show")
    uuid=$(awk '$1=="UUID:" {print $2}' <<<"$show")
    members=$(jq -cn --argjson members "$members" --arg name "$member" --argjson id "$id" --arg uuid "$uuid" '$members+{($name):{id:$id,uuid:$uuid}}')
done
# The same seed UUID is exposed by both the physical partition and RO loop.
# Resolve the unique physical partition, rather than udev's current UUID alias.
seed=$(lsblk -J -o PATH,TYPE,UUID | jq -er --arg uuid "$(jq -er .seed_fsid "$disk")" \
    '[..|objects|select(.uuid==$uuid and .type=="part")|.path]|select(length==1)|.[0]')
generation=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed" | awk '$1=="generation" {print $2; exit}')
image=$(jq -er .image "$disk")
[[ -f $image && ! -L $image && $(realpath -e "$image") == "$image" &&
   $(stat -c %i "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" &&
   $(stat -c %s "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ]] || fail 'prepared image pins differ'
# Names are neither allocated nor adopted here. The owner validates the
# CleanPlan native UUID/session/key and storage pins when committing this plan.
jq -n --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg seed "$seed" --arg etag "$etag" \
    --argjson generation "$generation" --argjson members "$members" \
    --argjson inode "$(stat -c %i "$image")" --argjson size "$(stat -c %s "$image")" \
    --argjson persist "$(stat -c %i "$root/@agent_user/persist")" \
    --slurpfile disk "$disk" --slurpfile container "$container" --slurpfile pool "$work/pool.json" \
    --slurpfile instance "$work/instance.json" --slurpfile old "$work/preflight.json" '
    $disk[0] as $d | $d.partition_table.partitions as $p |
    {version:4,session_id:$sid,wireguard_pubkey:$key,
     expected_revision:$old[0].expected_revision,expected_revision_operation_id:$old[0].expected_revision_operation_id,
     binding:{device_path:$d.image,mount_point:$d.root_mount,btrfs_uuid:$d.root_fsid,cozo_id:$sid,attached:true},
     seed_device:$seed,seed_fsid:$d.seed_fsid,seed_generation:$generation,leaf_inode:$inode,leaf_size:$size,
     members:$members,persist_inode:$persist,native_root:$container[0].threetched_root,
     pool_name:$pool[0].name,pool_source:$pool[0].config.source,instance_etag:$etag,instance:$instance[0],
     previous_instance_etag:"",previous_instance:null,
     partitioned_overlay:{disk_guid:($d.partition_table.id|ascii_downcase),
      root_partition:{partuuid:($p[0].uuid|ascii_downcase),start_sector:$p[0].start,sectors:$p[0].size},
      upgrade_partition:{partuuid:($p[1].uuid|ascii_downcase),start_sector:$p[1].start,sectors:$p[1].size},
      upgrade_fsid:$d.upgrade_fsid,host_upgrade_fsid:"5a88e7cd-9701-40a7-8301-ef076761886c"}}
' > "$work/plan.json"
[[ $(stat -c %s "$work/plan.json") -le 32768 ]] || fail 'plan exceeds owner bound'
# Stage on the plan directory's filesystem before exclusive publication.
plan_tmp=$(mktemp "$plans/.$sid.XXXXXX")
cat "$work/plan.json" > "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plan_tmp"
ln "$plan_tmp" "$plans/$sid.json"
rm -- "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plans/$sid.json"
sync -f "$plans"
digest=$(sha256sum "$plans/$sid.json"); digest=${digest%% *}
jq -cn --arg key "$key" --arg digest "$digest" '{wireguard_pubkey:$key,plan_sha256:$digest}' > "$work/provision-args.json"
printf 'Plan prepared, not adopted: %s\n' "$plans/$sid.json"
printf 'Declared operation: plugins/identity_sled/operations/provision_container/call\n'
printf 'Arguments: %s\n' "$work/provision-args.json"

    2> "$work/preflight-diagnostic"; then
    cat "$work/preflight-diagnostic" >&2
    fail 'owner preflight failed; retain evidence and do not retry through another identity or transport'
fi
# Keep only revision/native metadata; no SID1 is read or copied.
# V4 accepts only a fresh key or the exact explicit-deletion tombstone, as
# validated by identity_clean_provision.rs. Existing bound identities stay out.
jq -ce --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" '
    select(.plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.success==true and .plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.session_id==$sid and .wireguard_pubkey==$key) |
    select(.previous_instance==null and .previous_native_instance==null and .previous_instance_etag=="") |
    select((.expected_revision==0 and .expected_revision_operation_id=="") or
        ((.expected_revision|type)=="number" and .expected_revision>1 and
         .expected_revision<=9007199254740991 and .expected_revision==(.expected_revision|floor) and
         .expected_revision_operation_id==("delete-provision-"+$sid+"-"+((.expected_revision-1)|tostring)))) |
    {expected_revision,expected_revision_operation_id,previous_instance,previous_instance_etag}
' "$work/preflight-receipt.json" > "$work/preflight.json" || fail 'owner did not admit a fresh key or exact explicit-deletion preflight'
socket=/var/lib/incus/unix.socket
curl --silent --show-error --fail --noproxy '*' --max-time 30 --unix-socket "$socket" \
    --dump-header "$work/instance.headers" --output "$work/instance-response.json" \
    "http://unix.socket/1.0/instances/$name"
jq -ce --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" '
    select(.type=="sync" and .status_code==200)|.metadata|
    select(.name==$name and .type=="container" and .status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102 and
        .config["volatile.uuid"]==$uuid and .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and
        .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key)' \
    "$work/instance-response.json" > "$work/instance.json" || fail 'stopped Incus definition absent'
etag=$(awk 'tolower($1)=="etag:" {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); sub(/\r$/, ""); print}' "$work/instance.headers")
[[ -n $etag && $etag != *$'\n'* ]] || fail 'ambiguous Incus ETag'
timeout --kill-after=5s 30s incus --force-local --project default query /1.0/storage-pools/identity-roots > "$work/pool.json"
root=$(jq -er .root_mount "$disk")
[[ $root == "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" && $(findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs ]] || fail 'prepared root mount absent'
members='{}'
for member in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
    show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$root/$member")
    id=$(awk '$1=="Subvolume" && $2=="ID:" {print $3}' <<<"$show")
    uuid=$(awk '$1=="UUID:" {print $2}' <<<"$show")
    members=$(jq -cn --argjson members "$members" --arg name "$member" --argjson id "$id" --arg uuid "$uuid" '$members+{($name):{id:$id,uuid:$uuid}}')
done
# The same seed UUID is exposed by both the physical partition and RO loop.
# Resolve the unique physical partition, rather than udev's current UUID alias.
seed=$(lsblk -J -o PATH,TYPE,UUID | jq -er --arg uuid "$(jq -er .seed_fsid "$disk")" \
    '[..|objects|select(.uuid==$uuid and .type=="part")|.path]|select(length==1)|.[0]')
generation=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed" | awk '$1=="generation" {print $2; exit}')
image=$(jq -er .image "$disk")
[[ -f $image && ! -L $image && $(realpath -e "$image") == "$image" &&
   $(stat -c %i "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" &&
   $(stat -c %s "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ]] || fail 'prepared image pins differ'
# Names are neither allocated nor adopted here. The owner validates the
# CleanPlan native UUID/session/key and storage pins when committing this plan.
jq -n --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg seed "$seed" --arg etag "$etag" \
    --argjson generation "$generation" --argjson members "$members" \
    --argjson inode "$(stat -c %i "$image")" --argjson size "$(stat -c %s "$image")" \
    --argjson persist "$(stat -c %i "$root/@agent_user/persist")" \
    --slurpfile disk "$disk" --slurpfile container "$container" --slurpfile pool "$work/pool.json" \
    --slurpfile instance "$work/instance.json" --slurpfile old "$work/preflight.json" '
    $disk[0] as $d | $d.partition_table.partitions as $p |
    {version:4,session_id:$sid,wireguard_pubkey:$key,
     expected_revision:$old[0].expected_revision,expected_revision_operation_id:$old[0].expected_revision_operation_id,
     binding:{device_path:$d.image,mount_point:$d.root_mount,btrfs_uuid:$d.root_fsid,cozo_id:$sid,attached:true},
     seed_device:$seed,seed_fsid:$d.seed_fsid,seed_generation:$generation,leaf_inode:$inode,leaf_size:$size,
     members:$members,persist_inode:$persist,native_root:$container[0].threetched_root,
     pool_name:$pool[0].name,pool_source:$pool[0].config.source,instance_etag:$etag,instance:$instance[0],
     previous_instance_etag:"",previous_instance:null,
     partitioned_overlay:{disk_guid:($d.partition_table.id|ascii_downcase),
      root_partition:{partuuid:($p[0].uuid|ascii_downcase),start_sector:$p[0].start,sectors:$p[0].size},
      upgrade_partition:{partuuid:($p[1].uuid|ascii_downcase),start_sector:$p[1].start,sectors:$p[1].size},
      upgrade_fsid:$d.upgrade_fsid,host_upgrade_fsid:"5a88e7cd-9701-40a7-8301-ef076761886c"}}
' > "$work/plan.json"
[[ $(stat -c %s "$work/plan.json") -le 32768 ]] || fail 'plan exceeds owner bound'
# Stage on the plan directory's filesystem before exclusive publication.
plan_tmp=$(mktemp "$plans/.$sid.XXXXXX")
cat "$work/plan.json" > "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plan_tmp"
ln "$plan_tmp" "$plans/$sid.json"
rm -- "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plans/$sid.json"
sync -f "$plans"
digest=$(sha256sum "$plans/$sid.json"); digest=${digest%% *}
jq -cn --arg key "$key" --arg digest "$digest" '{wireguard_pubkey:$key,plan_sha256:$digest}' > "$work/provision-args.json"
printf 'Plan prepared, not adopted: %s\n' "$plans/$sid.json"
printf 'Declared operation: plugins/identity_sled/operations/provision_container/call\n'
printf 'Arguments: %s\n' "$work/provision-args.json"

#!/bin/sh
# Host storage owner: remount/receive existing GPT members, never mint/start.
set -eu
fail() { printf 'restore-chatbot-root: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
check_only=false
if [ "${1:-}" = --check ]; then check_only=true; shift; fi
[ "$#" -le 1 ] || fail 'usage: restore-chatbot-root [--check] [NAME]'
name=${1:-3tchedChatbot}
printf '%s' "$name" | grep -Eq '^(3tchedCtlChatbot|3tchedChatbot|ID-[1-9][0-9]*)$' && [ "${#name}" -le 63 ] || fail 'invalid chatbot selector'
# The name selects the native target; the same existing UUID/session/key and
# storage receipts below are required for both the legacy alias and ID-N.
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail 'host root required'
sid=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
key=[REDACTED:opaque-base64]
pool=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool
receipt=$pool/.provisioning/$name.boot.json
binding=$pool/.provisioning/$name.incus.json
disk=$pool/.provisioning/$name.json
root=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots/containers/$name/rootfs
view=$pool/.mounts/$name/root-view
seed_layer=$pool/.mounts/$name/seed-layer
upgrade_layer=$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade-layer
readback() { timeout --kill-after=5s 30s "$@"; }
secure_path() (
    path=$1
    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$path")" = "$path" ] || fail "noncanonical path: $path"
    while :; do
        [ ! -L "$path" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$path")" = 0 ] &&
            [ $((0$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022)) -eq 0 ] || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"
        [ "$path" != / ] || break
        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
    done
)
[ "$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSROOT)" = /@3tched-leaf-pool ] || fail 'leaf pool not mounted'
for file in "$receipt" "$binding" "$disk"; do
    secure_path "$file"
    [ -f "$file" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$file")" = 0:0:600 ] || fail "unsafe preparation receipt: $file"
done
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and
    .identity_registered==true and .restore_existing_pair==true
' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot boot attestation differs'
# The boot opt-in is not identity authority. Match the host preparation's
# existing native UUID/session/key and storage paths before any mount action.
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg root "$root" --arg view "$view" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and .phase=="root-bound" and
    .root_bound==true and .root_view_readonly==true and .upgrade_paired==true and
    .threetched_root==$root and .root_view==$view and .instance.name==$name and .instance.type=="container" and
    .instance.config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .instance.config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    (.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))
' "$binding" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot preparation pins differ'
uuid=$(jq -er '.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]' "$binding")
jq -e --arg uuid "$uuid" '
    (has("instance_uuid")|not) or .instance_uuid==$uuid
' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'boot native UUID differs'
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg image "$pool/$name.img" --arg root "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" \
    --arg upgrade "$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade" '
    .name==$name and .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1" and .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and
    .filesystem_prepared==true and .image==$image and .root_mount==$root and .upgrade_mount==$upgrade
' "$disk" >/dev/null || fail 'disk preparation pins differ'
image=$pool/$name.img
secure_path "$image"
[ -f "$image" ] && [ "$(stat -c %i "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" ] &&
    [ "$(stat -c %s "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ] || fail 'image pins differ'
instance=$(readback incus --force-local --project default query "/1.0/instances/$name") || fail 'native instance readback failed'
printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg uuid "$uuid" '
    .name==$name and .type=="container" and .config["volatile.uuid"]==$uuid and
    .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    .config["security.privileged"]=="false" and .config["security.protection.shift"]=="true" and
    .config["boot.autostart"]=="false" and .profiles==["3tched-lungs"] and
    .devices.root.type=="disk" and .devices.root.path=="/" and .devices.root.pool=="identity-roots" and
    ((.status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102) or (.status=="Running" and .status_code==103))
' >/dev/null || fail 'native chatbot UUID/session/key/policy differs'
state=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -er .status)
# Select the activated closure deliberately. When invoked from a source or
# received release, use that helper's sibling; never fall through to base copies.
self=$(realpath -e -- "$0") || fail 'cannot resolve restore helper'
helper_dir=$(dirname -- "$self")
case "$helper_dir" in
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched)
        helper_dir=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers ;;
esac
sync_helper=$helper_dir/sync-instance-upgrade
case "$self" in
    */deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/restore-chatbot-root)
        sync_helper=$helper_dir/../../scripts/sync-instance-upgrade.sh ;;
esac
sync_helper=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER:-$sync_helper}") || fail 'selected sync helper absent'
secure_path "$sync_helper"
[ -f "$sync_helper" ] && [ -x "$sync_helper" ] || fail 'selected sync helper not executable'
if [ "$state" = Running ]; then
    # A service restart observes only; it must not replace a running guest's lowers.
    [ "$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE)" = overlay ] || fail 'running root is not overlay'
    options=$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FS-OPTIONS) || fail 'cannot inspect running root'
    case ",$options," in *,"lowerdir=$upgrade_layer:$seed_layer",*) ;; *) fail 'running root lower pins differ' ;; esac
    case ",$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in *,ro,*) ;; *) fail 'running root is not read-only' ;; esac
    exit 0
fi
[ "$check_only" != true ] || exit 0
exec "$sync_helper" boot "$name"

#!/bin/sh
# Mount physical-seed roots after Incus API readiness, then start only ready
# session instances (including the fixed chatbot alias). Staging names remain
# stopped. This is storage
# readiness, without a bridge/lungs dependency. A service restart observes
# running instances without stopping them; finish never detaches their roots.
exec 2>&1
rm -f /run/opdbus/runit-ready/identity-roots

wait_dep() {
    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    i=0
    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        i=$((i + 1))
        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
        sleep 1
    done
}

wait_dep incus

i=0
until incus info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
        echo "incusd API not ready" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

helper=/usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root
gpt=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/.provisioning/3tchedChatbot.boot.json
if [ -e "$gpt" ] || [ -L "$gpt" ]; then
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched/restore-chatbot-root || exit 1
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched/runit-ready-signal identity-roots
    exec sleep infinity
fi
physical=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
legacy=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
physical_present=0
seed_readonly_ready=0
failed=0
for receipt in "$physical"/*/state.json; do
    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
    physical_present=1
    name=$(basename "$(dirname "$receipt")")
    if [ "$name" != 3tchedChatbot ] && ! printf '%s' "$name" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'; then
        echo "physical seed staging receipt $name: boot disabled"
        continue
    fi
    marker="$physical/$name/boot-ready.json"
    if [ ! -e "$marker" ] && [ ! -L "$marker" ]; then
        echo "physical seed $name: no authoritative-completion boot opt-in; skipped"
        continue
    fi
    # A canonical name alone does not prove provisioning completed. The helper
    # checks the owner attestation marker and all storage/native identity pins.
    if ! jq -e --arg name "$name" '
        .name == $name and .phase == "ready" and
        (.session == $name or ($name == "3tchedChatbot" and .session == "b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28"))
    ' "$receipt" >/dev/null; then
        echo "physical seed $name: invalid/incomplete receipt; legacy suppressed" >&2
        failed=$((failed + 1))
        continue
    fi
    start_on_boot=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot | select(type == "boolean") | tostring' "$marker") || {
        echo "physical seed $name: invalid boot completion policy" >&2
        failed=$((failed + 1))
        continue
    }
    # The physical partition's kernel RO flag is volatile across reboot.
    # The host owner restores it once, after ready/opt-in selection and before
    # any seed-check/up; verification failures stop boot restoration closed.
    if [ "$seed_readonly_ready" -eq 0 ]; then
        "$helper" seed-readonly || { echo "physical seed read-only enforcement failed" >&2; exit 1; }
        seed_readonly_ready=1
    fi
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$name/state" | jq -er '.status') || state=unknown
    case "$state" in
        Running)
            if "$helper" seed-check "$name"; then
                "$helper" seed-lungs "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        Stopped)
            if "$helper" seed-up "$name" && "$helper" seed-lungs "$name"; then
                if [ "$start_on_boot" = true ]; then incus start "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
                else echo "physical seed $name: storage restored; boot start disabled"; fi
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        *) echo "physical seed $name: unsupported native status $state" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
done
if [ "$physical_present" -eq 1 ]; then
    # A direct legacy lower mount conflicts with sprouts from the SAME seed,
    # even for a different identity. Do not invoke legacy `up` in this mode.
    for image in "$legacy"/*/identity.img; do
        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
        name=$(basename "$(dirname "$image")")
        if [ -e "$physical/$name/state.json" ] || [ -L "$physical/$name/state.json" ]; then
            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by physical seed receipt"
        else
            echo "legacy identity $name: migration or independent lower required; shared seed direct mount suppressed" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1))
        fi
    done
else
    "$helper" up || failed=$((failed + 1))

#!/bin/sh
# Mount physical-seed roots after Incus API readiness, then start only ready
# session instances (including the fixed chatbot alias). Staging names remain
# stopped. This is storage
# readiness, without a bridge/lungs dependency. A service restart observes
# running instances without stopping them; finish never detaches their roots.
exec 2>&1
rm -f /run/opdbus/runit-ready/identity-roots

wait_dep() {
    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    i=0
    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        i=$((i + 1))
        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
        sleep 1
    done
}

wait_dep incus

i=0
until incus info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
        echo "incusd API not ready" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

helper=/usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root
gpt=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/.provisioning/3tchedChatbot.boot.json
if [ -e "$gpt" ] || [ -L "$gpt" ]; then
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched/restore-chatbot-root || exit 1
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched/runit-ready-signal identity-roots
    exec sleep infinity
fi
physical=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
legacy=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
physical_present=0
seed_readonly_ready=0
failed=0
for receipt in "$physical"/*/state.json; do
    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
    physical_present=1
    name=$(basename "$(dirname "$receipt")")
    if [ "$name" != 3tchedChatbot ] && ! printf '%s' "$name" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'; then
        echo "physical seed staging receipt $name: boot disabled"
        continue
    fi
    marker="$physical/$name/boot-ready.json"
    if [ ! -e "$marker" ] && [ ! -L "$marker" ]; then
        echo "physical seed $name: no authoritative-completion boot opt-in; skipped"
        continue
    fi
    # A canonical name alone does not prove provisioning completed. The helper
    # checks the owner attestation marker and all storage/native identity pins.
    if ! jq -e --arg name "$name" '
        .name == $name and .phase == "ready" and
        (.session == $name or ($name == "3tchedChatbot" and .session == "b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28"))
    ' "$receipt" >/dev/null; then
        echo "physical seed $name: invalid/incomplete receipt; legacy suppressed" >&2
        failed=$((failed + 1))
        continue
    fi
    start_on_boot=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot | select(type == "boolean") | tostring' "$marker") || {
        echo "physical seed $name: invalid boot completion policy" >&2
        failed=$((failed + 1))
        continue
    }
    # The physical partition's kernel RO flag is volatile across reboot.
    # The host owner restores it once, after ready/opt-in selection and before
    # any seed-check/up; verification failures stop boot restoration closed.
    if [ "$seed_readonly_ready" -eq 0 ]; then
        "$helper" seed-readonly || { echo "physical seed read-only enforcement failed" >&2; exit 1; }
        seed_readonly_ready=1
    fi
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$name/state" | jq -er '.status') || state=unknown
    case "$state" in
        Running)
            if "$helper" seed-check "$name"; then
                "$helper" seed-lungs "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        Stopped)
            if "$helper" seed-up "$name" && "$helper" seed-lungs "$name"; then
                if [ "$start_on_boot" = true ]; then incus start "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
                else echo "physical seed $name: storage restored; boot start disabled"; fi
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        *) echo "physical seed $name: unsupported native status $state" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
done
if [ "$physical_present" -eq 1 ]; then
    # A direct legacy lower mount conflicts with sprouts from the SAME seed,
    # even for a different identity. Do not invoke legacy `up` in this mode.
    for image in "$legacy"/*/identity.img; do
        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
        name=$(basename "$(dirname "$image")")
        if [ -e "$physical/$name/state.json" ] || [ -L "$physical/$name/state.json" ]; then
            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by physical seed receipt"
        else
            echo "legacy identity $name: migration or independent lower required; shared seed direct mount suppressed" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1))
        fi
    done
else
    "$helper" up || failed=$((failed + 1))
    "$helper" status || failed=$((failed + 1))
fi
[ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$failed identity root startup check(s) failed" >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/local/libexec/3tched/runit-ready-signal identity-roots
exec sleep infinity

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

LAYOUT=shared-partition-siblings-v2
SCHEMA_VERSION=1
IMAGE_REL=@/usr/share/op-dbus/image
MEMBERS=$'@\n@agent_memory\n@agent_rules\n@agent_shared\n@agent_skills\n@agent_soul\n@agent_user'
ARTIFACTS=(release.json provenance.json layout.json packages.tsv components.tsv critical-files.json critical-files.sha256 maintenance.txt)
CRITICAL_PATHS=(etc/os-release etc/fstab usr/lib/systemd/systemd usr/sbin/init)
REQUIRED_COMPONENTS=(base-files dpkg systemd systemd-sysv)

fail() { printf 'op-identity-image: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
usage() {
    cat >&2 <<'EOF'
Usage:
  op-identity-image prepare TOP RELEASE_ID PROVENANCE_JSON
  op-identity-image verify TOP
  op-identity-image verify-metadata TOP
  op-identity-image inspect TOP

TOP is an already mounted Btrfs top-level directory containing exactly the
seven shared workspace sibling subvolumes. prepare writes image metadata and
two runtime mountpoint directories inside @; it never mounts, formats, changes
seeding state, copies a root tree, or creates a subvolume.
EOF
    exit 2
}

canonical_top() {
    local input=$1 resolved
    [[ -d $input && ! -L $input ]] || fail "TOP must be an existing ordinary directory: $input"
    resolved=$(realpath -e -- "$input") || fail "cannot resolve TOP"
    [[ $resolved == "$input" && $resolved != / ]] || fail "TOP must be an absolute canonical path other than /"
    TOP=$resolved
    GUEST=$TOP/@
    [[ -d $GUEST && ! -L $GUEST ]] || fail "TOP/@ must be an ordinary guest root directory"
}

safe_dir_chain() {
    local rel=$1 path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "unsafe or missing directory component: $path"
    done
}

metadata_dir() {
    safe_dir_chain '@'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    IMAGE=$TOP/$IMAGE_REL
    [[ -d $IMAGE && ! -L $IMAGE ]] || fail 'image metadata directory is missing or unsafe'
}

prepare_metadata_parent() {
    local path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
            [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory metadata parent: $path"
        else
            mkdir -- "$path" || fail "cannot create metadata parent: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path"
        fi
    done
    IMAGE=$path/image
}

hash_file() {
    local file=$1 value
    [[ -f $file && ! -L $file ]] || fail "expected ordinary file: $file"
    value=$(sha256sum -- "$file") || fail "cannot hash $file"
    printf '%s' "${value%% *}"
}

within_guest() {
    local path=$1 resolved
    [[ -e $path || -L $path ]] || fail "missing critical path: ${path#"$GUEST"/}"
    resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "${path#"$GUEST"/}") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
    [[ -f $resolved ]] || fail "critical path does not resolve to a regular file: $path"
}

# Resolve symlinks using guest-root semantics. Host realpath follows absolute
# guest symlinks from the host's /, which both rejects valid links and risks
# hashing a host file. Absolute targets here restart at GUEST instead.
resolve_guest_path() {
    local rel=$1 component candidate target target_rel resolved_rel
    local -a todo=() target_parts=() stack=()
    local links=0 index
    [[ $rel != /* ]] || return 1
    IFS=/ read -r -a todo <<< "$rel"
    while ((${#todo[@]})); do
        component=${todo[0]}
        todo=("${todo[@]:1}")
        case $component in
            ''|.) continue ;;
            ..)
                ((${#stack[@]})) || return 1
                stack=("${stack[@]:0:${#stack[@]}-1}")
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
        candidate=$GUEST
        [[ -z $resolved_rel ]] || candidate=$candidate/$resolved_rel
        candidate=$candidate/$component
        if [[ -L $candidate ]]; then
            ((links+=1))
            ((links <= 40)) || return 1
            target=$(readlink -- "$candidate") || return 1
            target_rel=$target
            if [[ $target == /* ]]; then
                stack=()
                target_rel=${target#/}
            fi
            IFS=/ read -r -a target_parts <<< "$target_rel"
            todo=("${target_parts[@]}" "${todo[@]}")
            continue
        fi
        if ((${#todo[@]})) && [[ ! -d $candidate ]]; then return 1; fi
        stack+=("$component")
    done
    resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
    [[ -n $resolved_rel ]] || return 1
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$GUEST" "$resolved_rel"
}

prepare_mountpoint_dirs() {
    local rel path component
    local -a parts=()
    for rel in run run/mount run/mount/3tchedfs run/opdbus run/opdbus/lungs; do
        path=$GUEST
        IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
        for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
            path=$path/$component
            if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
                [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory guest runtime path: $path"
            else
                mkdir -m 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot create guest runtime directory: $path"
            fi
            chown 0:0 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory owner: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory mode: $path"
        done
    done
}

critical_file_records() {
    local rel path resolved hash link target
    local records='{}'
    for rel in "${CRITICAL_PATHS[@]}"; do
        path=$GUEST/$rel
        within_guest "$path"
        resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "$rel") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
        hash=$(hash_file "$resolved")
        link=''
        if [[ -L $path ]]; then link=$(readlink -- "$path"); fi
        records=$(jq -cn --argjson old "$records" --arg rel "$rel" --arg sha "$hash" --arg link "$link" \
            '$old + {($rel):{sha256:$sha,symlink_target:$link}}')
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$records"
}

extract_os_release() {
    local key=$1 release_file
    release_file=$(resolve_guest_path etc/os-release) || fail 'cannot resolve guest OS release file'
    [[ -f $release_file && ! -L $release_file ]] || fail 'guest OS release is not a regular file'
    awk -F= -v key="$key" '$1 == key {value=substr($0, length(key)+2); if (value ~ /^".*"$/ || value ~ /^\047.*\047$/) value=substr(value,2,length(value)-2); print value; exit}' "$release_file"
}

neutral_defaults() {
    local machine=empty hostname=absent name=''
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/machine-id || -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/machine-id && ! -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id must be absent or an ordinary empty file before sealing'
        [[ ! -s $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id is not neutral; preserve it for operator review'
    else
        machine=absent
    fi
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/hostname || -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/hostname && ! -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]] || fail '/etc/hostname must be an ordinary file before sealing'
        name=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$GUEST/etc/hostname")
        case "$name" in ''|localhost|localhost.localdomain|ubuntu) ;; *) fail '/etc/hostname contains a non-neutral value; preserve it for operator review' ;; esac
        hostname=$name
    fi
    if [[ -d $GUEST/etc/ssh ]]; then
        [[ -z $(find "$GUEST/etc/ssh" -maxdepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -name 'ssh_host_*' -print -quit) ]] || fail 'SSH host keys exist in the shared base; preserve them for operator review'
    fi
    jq -cn --arg machine "$machine" --arg hostname "$hostname" \
        '{machine_id:$machine,hostname:$hostname,ssh_host_keys:"absent"}'
}

package_inventory() {
    local status=$GUEST/var/lib/dpkg/status tmp=$1
    [[ -f $status && ! -L $status ]] || fail 'complete offline dpkg status database is missing'
    awk '
        BEGIN { RS=""; FS="\n"; bad=0 }
        {
            package=""; version=""; installed=0
            for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if (substr($i,1,9)=="Package: ") package=substr($i,10)
                else if (substr($i,1,9)=="Version: ") version=substr($i,10)
                else if ($i=="Status: install ok installed") installed=1
            }
            if (installed) {
                if (package=="" || version=="" || package ~ /[\t\r\n ]/ || version ~ /[\t\r\n ]/) bad=1
                else print package "\t" version
            }
        }
        END { if (bad) exit 3 }
    ' "$status" | LC_ALL=C sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k1,1 > "$tmp" || fail 'dpkg status database has incomplete installed-package records'
    [[ -s $tmp ]] || fail 'dpkg status database contains no installed package records'
    [[ $(cut -f1 "$tmp" | uniq -d | wc -l) -eq 0 ]] || fail 'duplicate package names in installed-package inventory'
}

check_layout() {
    local actual expected name
    command -v btrfs >/dev/null || fail 'btrfs-progs is required for full layout verification'
    actual=$(btrfs subvolume list "$TOP" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort) || fail 'cannot list Btrfs subvolumes under TOP'
    expected=$(printf '%s\n' $MEMBERS | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail 'TOP must contain exactly the seven declared flat sibling subvolumes'
    for name in $MEMBERS; do [[ -d $TOP/$name && ! -L $TOP/$name ]] || fail "missing or unsafe sibling: $name"; done
}

safe_dir_chain() {
    local rel=$1 path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "unsafe or missing directory component: $path"
    done
}

metadata_dir() {
    safe_dir_chain '@'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    IMAGE=$TOP/$IMAGE_REL
    [[ -d $IMAGE && ! -L $IMAGE ]] || fail 'image metadata directory is missing or unsafe'
}

prepare_metadata_parent() {
    local path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
            [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory metadata parent: $path"
        else
            mkdir -- "$path" || fail "cannot create metadata parent: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path"
        fi
    done
    IMAGE=$path/image
}

hash_file() {
    local file=$1 value
    [[ -f $file && ! -L $file ]] || fail "expected ordinary file: $file"
    value=$(sha256sum -- "$file") || fail "cannot hash $file"
    printf '%s' "${value%% *}"
}

within_guest() {
    local path=$1 resolved
    [[ -e $path || -L $path ]] || fail "missing critical path: ${path#"$GUEST"/}"
    resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "${path#"$GUEST"/}") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
    [[ -f $resolved ]] || fail "critical path does not resolve to a regular file: $path"
}

# Resolve symlinks using guest-root semantics. Host realpath follows absolute
# guest symlinks from the host's /, which both rejects valid links and risks
# hashing a host file. Absolute targets here restart at GUEST instead.
resolve_guest_path() {
    local rel=$1 component candidate target target_rel resolved_rel
    local -a todo=() target_parts=() stack=()
    local links=0 index
    [[ $rel != /* ]] || return 1
    IFS=/ read -r -a todo <<< "$rel"
    while ((${#todo[@]})); do
        component=${todo[0]}
        todo=("${todo[@]:1}")
        case $component in
            ''|.) continue ;;
            ..)
                ((${#stack[@]})) || return 1
                stack=("${stack[@]:0:${#stack[@]}-1}")
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
        candidate=$GUEST
        [[ -z $resolved_rel ]] || candidate=$candidate/$resolved_rel
        candidate=$candidate/$component
        if [[ -L $candidate ]]; then
            ((links+=1))
            ((links <= 40)) || return 1
            target=$(readlink -- "$candidate") || return 1
            target_rel=$target
            if [[ $target == /* ]]; then
                stack=()
                target_rel=${target#/}
            fi
            IFS=/ read -r -a target_parts <<< "$target_rel"
            todo=("${target_parts[@]}" "${todo[@]}")
            continue
        fi
        if ((${#todo[@]})) && [[ ! -d $candidate ]]; then return 1; fi
        stack+=("$component")
    done
    resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
    [[ -n $resolved_rel ]] || return 1
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$GUEST" "$resolved_rel"
}

prepare_mountpoint_dirs() {
    local rel path component
    local -a parts=()
    for rel in run run/mount run/mount/3tchedfs run/opdbus run/opdbus/lungs; do
        path=$GUEST
        IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
        for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
            path=$path/$component
            if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
                [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory guest runtime path: $path"
            else
                mkdir -m 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot create guest runtime directory: $path"
            fi
            chown 0:0 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory owner: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory mode: $path"
        done
    done
}

critical_file_records() {
    local rel path resolved hash link target
    local records='{}'
    for rel in "${CRITICAL_PATHS[@]}"; do
        path=$GUEST/$rel
        within_guest "$path"
        resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "$rel") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
        hash=$(hash_file "$resolved")
        link=''
        if [[ -L $path ]]; then link=$(readlink -- "$path"); fi
        records=$(jq -cn --argjson old "$records" --arg rel "$rel" --arg sha "$hash" --arg link "$link" \
            '$old + {($rel):{sha256:$sha,symlink_target:$link}}')
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$records"
}

extract_os_release() {
    local key=$1 release_file
    release_file=$(resolve_guest_path etc/os-release) || fail 'cannot resolve guest OS release file'
    [[ -f $release_file && ! -L $release_file ]] || fail 'guest OS release is not a regular file'
    awk -F= -v key="$key" '$1 == key {value=substr($0, length(key)+2); if (value ~ /^".*"$/ || value ~ /^\047.*\047$/) value=substr(value,2,length(value)-2); print value; exit}' "$release_file"
}

neutral_defaults() {
    local machine=empty hostname=absent name=''
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/machine-id || -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/machine-id && ! -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id must be absent or an ordinary empty file before sealing'
        [[ ! -s $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id is not neutral; preserve it for operator review'
    else
        machine=absent
    fi
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/hostname || -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/hostname && ! -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]] || fail '/etc/hostname must be an ordinary file before sealing'
        name=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$GUEST/etc/hostname")
        case "$name" in ''|localhost|localhost.localdomain|ubuntu) ;; *) fail '/etc/hostname contains a non-neutral value; preserve it for operator review' ;; esac
        hostname=$name
    fi
    if [[ -d $GUEST/etc/ssh ]]; then
        [[ -z $(find "$GUEST/etc/ssh" -maxdepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -name 'ssh_host_*' -print -quit) ]] || fail 'SSH host keys exist in the shared base; preserve them for operator review'
    fi
    jq -cn --arg machine "$machine" --arg hostname "$hostname" \
        '{machine_id:$machine,hostname:$hostname,ssh_host_keys:"absent"}'
}

package_inventory() {
    local status=$GUEST/var/lib/dpkg/status tmp=$1
    [[ -f $status && ! -L $status ]] || fail 'complete offline dpkg status database is missing'
    awk '
        BEGIN { RS=""; FS="\n"; bad=0 }
        {
            package=""; version=""; installed=0
            for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if (substr($i,1,9)=="Package: ") package=substr($i,10)
                else if (substr($i,1,9)=="Version: ") version=substr($i,10)
                else if ($i=="Status: install ok installed") installed=1
            }
            if (installed) {
                if (package=="" || version=="" || package ~ /[\t\r\n ]/ || version ~ /[\t\r\n ]/) bad=1
                else print package "\t" version
            }
        }
        END { if (bad) exit 3 }
    ' "$status" | LC_ALL=C sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k1,1 > "$tmp" || fail 'dpkg status database has incomplete installed-package records'
    [[ -s $tmp ]] || fail 'dpkg status database contains no installed package records'
    [[ $(cut -f1 "$tmp" | uniq -d | wc -l) -eq 0 ]] || fail 'duplicate package names in installed-package inventory'
}

check_layout() {
    local actual expected name
    command -v btrfs >/dev/null || fail 'btrfs-progs is required for full layout verification'
    actual=$(btrfs subvolume list "$TOP" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort) || fail 'cannot list Btrfs subvolumes under TOP'
    expected=$(printf '%s\n' $MEMBERS | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail 'TOP must contain exactly the seven declared flat sibling subvolumes'
    for name in $MEMBERS; do [[ -d $TOP/$name && ! -L $TOP/$name ]] || fail "missing or unsafe sibling: $name"; done
}

layout_json() {
    jq -cn --arg layout "$LAYOUT" '
      {layout:$layout,
       members:[
         {subvolume:"@",mountpoint:"/",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_memory",mountpoint:"/agent/memory",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_rules",mountpoint:"/agent/rules",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_shared",mountpoint:"/agent/shared",guest_mode:"ro"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_skills",mountpoint:"/agent/skills",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_soul",mountpoint:"/agent/soul",guest_mode:"ro"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_user",mountpoint:"/agent/user",guest_mode:"rw"}
       ],
       persistence:{source:"@agent_user/persist",kind:"ordinary-directory",guest_mountpoint:"/opt/run-mounts/persist",guest_mode:"rw"},
       runtime_mounts:[
         {path:"/run",owner:"incus-profile:3tched-lungs",filesystem:"tmpfs",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/run/opdbus/lungs",source:"/run/opdbus/lungs",owner:"incus-profile:3tched-lungs",filesystem:"bind",guest_mode:"ro",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/run/mount/3tchedfs",owner:"guest:3tchedfs.service",filesystem:"fuse.3tchedFS",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/dev/shm/opdbus-physical-lungs/<native-session-uuid>",owner:"host",filesystem:"tmpfs",lifetime:"per-boot",seed_storage:false}
       ]}'
}

layout_check_json() {
    local file=$IMAGE/layout.json expected actual
    expected=$(layout_json | jq -cS .)
    actual=$(jq -cS . "$file") || fail 'layout metadata is not valid JSON'
    [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail 'layout metadata schema or exact member/mount set is invalid'
}

metadata_file_hashes() {
    local out='{}' name hash
    for name in "${ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
        hash=$(hash_file "$IMAGE/$name")
        out=$(jq -cn --argjson old "$out" --arg name "$name" --arg hash "$hash" '$old+{($name):$hash}')
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$out"
}

manifest_digest() { hash_file "$IMAGE/manifest.json"; }

check_manifest() {
    local actual name manifest_layout release
    for name in manifest.json "${ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
        [[ -f $IMAGE/$name && ! -L $IMAGE/$name ]] || fail "missing or unsafe metadata file: $name"
    done
    jq -e --arg layout "$LAYOUT" --argjson version "$SCHEMA_VERSION" '
      (keys|sort)==["artifact_sha256","critical_files","layout","neutral_defaults","package_count","release_id","schema_version"] and
      .schema_version==$version and .layout==$layout and
      (.release_id|type=="string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,127}$")) and
      (.package_count|type=="number" and .>0 and floor==.) and
      (.critical_files|keys|sort)==["etc/fstab","etc/os-release","usr/lib/systemd/systemd","usr/sbin/init"] and
      (.artifact_sha256|keys|sort)==["components.tsv","critical-files.json","critical-files.sha256","layout.json","maintenance.txt","packages.tsv","provenance.json","release.json"] and
      all(.artifact_sha256[]; type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")) and
      (.neutral_defaults|keys|sort)==["hostname","machine_id","ssh_host_keys"] and
      .neutral_defaults.ssh_host_keys=="absent"
    ' "$IMAGE/manifest.json" >/dev/null || fail 'manifest schema, pins, or exact members are invalid'
    for name in "${ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
        actual=$(hash_file "$IMAGE/$name")
        expected=$(jq -er --arg name "$name" '.artifact_sha256[$name]' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
        [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail "metadata artifact digest mismatch: $name"
    done
    layout_check_json
    release=$(jq -er '.release_id' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
    manifest_layout=$(jq -er '.layout' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
    [[ $manifest_layout == "$LAYOUT" && -n $release ]] || fail 'release or layout pin mismatch'
}

json_receipt() {
    jq -cn --arg release "$(jq -er '.release_id' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")" \
        --arg layout "$LAYOUT" --arg digest "$(manifest_digest)" \
        --argjson version "$SCHEMA_VERSION" \
        '{schema_version:$version,release_id:$release,layout:$layout,manifest_sha256:$digest}'
}

verify_metadata() {
    check_manifest
    json_receipt
}

verify_full() {
    local expected_packages actual_packages expected_critical actual_critical
    check_layout
    check_manifest
    expected_packages=$(jq -er '.package_count' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
    actual_packages=$(mktemp)
    package_inventory "$actual_packages"
    [[ $(wc -l < "$actual_packages") -eq $expected_packages ]] || { rm -f -- "$actual_packages"; fail 'installed-package count differs from prepared inventory'; }
    cmp -s -- "$actual_packages" "$IMAGE/packages.tsv" || { rm -f -- "$actual_packages"; fail 'installed-package inventory differs from prepared base'; }
    rm -f -- "$actual_packages"
    expected_critical=$(jq -cS '.critical_files' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
    actual_critical=$(critical_file_records)
    [[ $(printf '%s' "$actual_critical" | jq -cS .) == "$expected_critical" ]] || fail 'critical file digest or symlink target differs from prepared base'
    local expected_defaults actual_defaults
    expected_defaults=$(jq -cS '.neutral_defaults' "$IMAGE/manifest.json")
    actual_defaults=$(neutral_defaults)
    [[ $(jq -cS . <<<"$actual_defaults") == "$expected_defaults" ]] || fail 'preseal neutral identity defaults differ'
    json_receipt
}

prepare() {
    local release_id=$1 provenance_input=$2 stage status id version packages_tmp components_tmp \
        critical release layout package_count artifact_hashes defaults id_value version_value fstab_status
    [[ $release_id =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,127}$ ]] || fail 'invalid release ID'
    [[ $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'prepare requires host root to create root-owned guest mountpoint directories'
    [[ -f $provenance_input && ! -L $provenance_input && -r $provenance_input ]] || fail 'provenance input must be an ordinary readable JSON file'
    [[ $(stat -c %s -- "$provenance_input") -le 16384 ]] || fail 'provenance input exceeds 16 KiB'
    jq -e '
      (keys|sort)==["archive_name","archive_sha256","archive_url","checksum_url","signature_url","signer_primary_fingerprint","verified_at_utc"] and
      .archive_name=="ubuntu-26.04-server-cloudimg-amd64-root.tar.xz" and
      (.archive_sha256|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")) and
      (.signer_primary_fingerprint|type=="string" and test("^[A-F0-9]{40}$")) and
      .signer_primary_fingerprint=="D2EB44626FDDC30B513D5BB71A5D6C4C7DB87C81" and
      ([.archive_url,.checksum_url,.signature_url]|all(type=="string" and startswith("https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/resolute/release-20260927/"))) and
      (.verified_at_utc|type=="string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$"))
    ' "$provenance_input" >/dev/null || fail 'provenance schema or Canonical source pins are invalid'
    prepare_metadata_parent
    [[ ! -e $IMAGE && ! -L $IMAGE ]] || fail 'metadata target already exists; refusing to adopt or overwrite it'
    check_layout
    within_guest "$GUEST/etc/os-release"
    [[ $(extract_os_release ID) == ubuntu && $(extract_os_release VERSION_ID) == 26.04 ]] || fail 'guest root is not Ubuntu 26.04'
    defaults=$(neutral_defaults)
    prepare_mountpoint_dirs
    id_value=$(extract_os_release ID)
    version_value=$(extract_os_release VERSION_ID)
    mkdir -- "$IMAGE"
    chmod 0755 -- "$IMAGE"
    cp -- "$provenance_input" "$IMAGE/provenance.json"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/provenance.json"
    jq -cn --arg release "$release_id" --arg os_id "$id_value" --arg version "$version_value" \
        --arg archive "ubuntu-26.04-server-cloudimg-amd64-root.tar.xz" \
        '{release_id:$release,os:{id:$os_id,version_id:$version},source_archive:$archive}' > "$IMAGE/release.json"
    layout_json > "$IMAGE/layout.json"
    packages_tmp=$(mktemp)
    package_inventory "$packages_tmp"
    package_count=$(wc -l < "$packages_tmp" | tr -d ' ')
    mv -- "$packages_tmp" "$IMAGE/packages.tsv"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/release.json" "$IMAGE/layout.json" "$IMAGE/packages.tsv"
    components_tmp=$(mktemp)
    printf 'component\tstatus\tversion\trequired_for\n' > "$components_tmp"
    for id in "${REQUIRED_COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
        version=$(awk -F '\t' -v package="$id" '$1==package {print $2; found=1; exit} END {if (!found) print "missing"}' "$IMAGE/packages.tsv")
        if [[ $version == missing ]]; then status=missing; else status=present; fi
        case $id in
            base-files) release='OS identity and base filesystem metadata' ;;
            dpkg) release='offline installed-package inventory' ;;
            systemd) release='system init and service manager' ;;
            systemd-sysv) release='SysV init compatibility entry point' ;;
        esac
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$status" "$version" "$release" >> "$components_tmp"
    done
    mv -- "$components_tmp" "$IMAGE/components.tsv"
    critical=$(critical_file_records)
    printf '%s\n' "$critical" > "$IMAGE/critical-files.json"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/components.tsv" "$IMAGE/critical-files.json"
    cat > "$IMAGE/maintenance.txt" <<'EOF'
This is immutable shared-seed provenance and layout metadata. Keep the seed
unchanged while any sprout depends on it. Updating the seed in place invalidates
existing sprouts. Do not store session identity, credentials, SSH host keys,
machine IDs, or per-container runtime state in the seed. Prepare recovery tools
and a copy of this manifest outside the seed so recovery does not depend on
mounting the base. Host-provided 3tchedFS and its private state live outside the
seed; the private process state is on host tmpfs and is recreated per boot.
EOF
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/maintenance.txt"
    release=$(jq -cS . "$IMAGE/release.json")
    layout=$(jq -cS . "$IMAGE/layout.json")
    [[ -n $release && -n $layout ]] || fail 'generated release/layout metadata is empty'
    cat > "$IMAGE/critical-files.sha256" <<EOF
$(jq -r 'to_entries|sort_by(.key)[]|"\(.value.sha256)  \(.key)"' <<<"$critical")
EOF
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/critical-files.sha256"
    artifact_hashes=$(metadata_file_hashes)
    defaults=$(jq -cS . <<<"$defaults")
    jq -cnS --arg release "$release_id" --arg layout "$LAYOUT" \
       --argjson version "$SCHEMA_VERSION" --argjson count "$package_count" \
       --argjson critical "$critical" --argjson defaults "$defaults" \
       --argjson artifacts "$artifact_hashes" \
       '{schema_version:$version,release_id:$release,layout:$layout,package_count:$count,critical_files:$critical,neutral_defaults:$defaults,artifact_sha256:$artifacts}' \
       > "$IMAGE/manifest.json"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/manifest.json"
    # Validate the just-created metadata and the complete unsealed tree.
    verify_full >/dev/null
    printf 'prepared image metadata under %s\n' "$IMAGE"
}

main() {
    [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || usage
    local command=$1
    shift
    case "$command" in
        prepare)
            [[ $# -eq 3 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            prepare "$2" "$3"
            ;;
        verify)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_full
            ;;
        verify-metadata)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_metadata
            ;;
        inspect)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_full >/dev/null
            jq -S . "$IMAGE/manifest.json"
            ;;
        *) usage ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

        if [[ $version == missing ]]; then status=missing; else status=present; fi

            systemd-sysv) release='SysV init compatibility entry point' ;;

    mv -- "$components_tmp" "$IMAGE/components.tsv"
    critical=$(critical_file_records)
    printf '%s\n' "$critical" > "$IMAGE/critical-files.json"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/components.tsv" "$IMAGE/critical-files.json"
    cat > "$IMAGE/maintenance.txt" <<'EOF'
This is immutable shared-seed provenance and layout metadata. Keep the seed
unchanged while any sprout depends on it. Updating the seed in place invalidates
existing sprouts. Do not store session identity, credentials, SSH host keys,

and a copy of this manifest outside the seed so recovery does not depend on

    layout=$(jq -cS . "$IMAGE/layout.json")

    cat > "$IMAGE/critical-files.sha256" <<EOF

       --argjson critical "$critical" --argjson defaults "$defaults" \
       --argjson artifacts "$artifact_hashes" \

       > "$IMAGE/manifest.json"
    chmod 0444 -- "$IMAGE/manifest.json"

    verify_full >/dev/null
    printf 'prepared image metadata under %s\n' "$IMAGE"
}

main() {
    [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || usage
    local command=$1
    shift
    case "$command" in
        prepare)
            [[ $# -eq 3 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            prepare "$2" "$3"
            ;;
        verify)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_full
            ;;
        verify-metadata)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_metadata
            ;;
        inspect)
            [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
            canonical_top "$1"
            metadata_dir
            verify_full >/dev/null
            jq -S . "$IMAGE/manifest.json"
            ;;
        *) usage ;;
    esac
}

seed_instance() {

seed_write() {

seed_read() {

        .version == 1 and .layout == "shared-partition-siblings-v2" and .name == $name and .phase == "ready" and

    leaf_loop=$(jq -r '.leaf_loop' "$seed_dir/state.json")

seed_boot_selection() {

seed_boot_name() {

        .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]=="[REDACTED:opaque-base64]" and

seed_verify_boot_marker() {

seed_enable_boot() {

seed_load() {

seed_lungs_paths() {

seed_lungs_verify() {

        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o SOURCE)" = 3tchedFS ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o ID)" = "$(jq -er '.mount_id' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "unexpected lungs mount"

seed_lungs() {

seed_unlungs() {

seed_verify_volume() {

    printf '%s' "$leaf_size" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,13}$' || seed_fail "size must be integer bytes"

    [ ! -e "$leaf" ] && [ ! -L "$leaf" ] && [ ! -e "$seed_dir/state.json" ] || seed_fail "existing leaf or descriptor; never retry creation"
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$leaf")"
    [ "$(stat -c %a "$(dirname -- "$leaf")")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "leaf parent must be private"
    [ "$(realpath -m -- "$leaf")" = "$leaf" ] || seed_fail "leaf path must be normalized and absolute"
    seed_instance
    seed_empty_native_root
    ! mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "candidate root is already mounted"
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg gen "$source_generation" --arg leaf "$leaf" --arg size "$leaf_size" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" '
        {version:1,layout:"shared-partition-siblings-v2",image:{},members:{},persist:{},name:$name,session:$sid,phase:"create-intent",seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$gen,leaf:$leaf,leaf_inode:"",leaf_size:$size,sprout_fsid:"",instance_uuid:$uuid,root:$root,seed_loop:"",leaf_loop:"",boot_id:$boot}
    ' > "$seed_dir/state.json" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
    ( set -C; : > "$leaf" )
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
    truncate -s "$leaf_size" "$leaf"
    sync -f "$leaf"
    seed_write --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" '.leaf_inode=$inode'
    seed_view= leaf_loop=
    seed_attach
    mount -t btrfs -o "ro,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view" "$seed_view" "$seed_dir/volume"
    # Validate the inherited siblings before creating the sprout. Nothing is
    # copied or snapshotted; all writes after ADD_DEV go to this new leaf.
    initial_members=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "seed lacks seven distinct sibling subvolumes"
    initial_image=$(seed_image_metadata verify) || seed_fail "seed image verification failed before device add"
    seed_write --argjson image "$initial_image" '.image=$image'
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@" ro)" = ro=false ] || seed_fail "seed @ must be a normal writable subvolume"
    [ -d "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] || seed_fail "seed root lacks safe etc directory"
    seed_write --argjson members "$initial_members" '.members=$members'
    current_seed_super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed lost block read-only enforcement"
    printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | grep -q SEEDING &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_fsid" ] &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "seed changed before sprout creation"
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_write '.phase="device-add-intent"'
    btrfs device add "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    umount "$seed_dir/volume"
    sprout_fsid=$(seed_super "$leaf")
    valid_session "$sprout_fsid" && [ "$sprout_fsid" != "$source_fsid" ] || seed_fail "invalid new sprout FSID"
    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_verify_volume
    [ "$(seed_layout_pins | jq -cS .)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$initial_members" | jq -cS .)" ] || seed_fail "inherited sibling identities changed after sprout creation"
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    # Parent and targets are ordinary directories in the leaf's COW root.
    for target in agent opt opt/run-mounts opt/run-mounts/persist; do
        [ ! -L "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink guest parent or persistence target"
        [ -e "$guest/$target" ] || mkdir -- "$guest/$target"
        [ -d "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "guest target is not a directory"
    done
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "agent parent must be ordinary directory"; fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        target=$guest/agent/$member
        [ ! -L "$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink agent target"
        [ -e "$target" ] || mkdir -- "$target"
        [ -d "$target" ] && [ -z "$(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "agent target is not an empty directory"
    done
    [ -z "$(find "$guest/opt/run-mounts/persist" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "persist target is not empty"
    persist_dir=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist
    [ ! -e "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] || seed_fail "seed already includes persistence directory; never adopt or overwrite"
    mkdir -m 700 -- "$persist_dir"
    persist_pin=$(seed_persist_pin)
    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
    for member in shared soul; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
    done
    for member in memory rules skills user; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
    done
    seed_write_hostname
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_instance
    seed_mount_guest
    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
}
seed_mode() (
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
    mode=$1 seed_name=$2

    seed_allow_running=false
    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

# Remove a retired host-side lungs mount and its Incus disk device.
#
# Earlier releases mounted 3tchedFS on the host per session and bound that
# mount in at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Identities that were provisioned then
# still carry the device, so starting one would otherwise keep the host mount
# alive beside the in-guest one.
retire_host_lungs_mount() {
    session=$1
    if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device remove "$session" 3tched >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            log "$session: could not remove the retired 3tched disk device"
    fi
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    return 0
}

# Remove a retired host-side lungs mount and its Incus disk device.
#
# Earlier releases mounted 3tchedFS on the host per session and bound that
# mount in at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Identities that were provisioned then
# still carry the device, so starting one would otherwise keep the host mount
# alive beside the in-guest one.
retire_host_lungs_mount() {
    session=$1
    if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device remove "$session" 3tched >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            log "$session: could not remove the retired 3tched disk device"
    fi
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    return 0
}

seed_instance() {

seed_verify_loop() {

    ' >/dev/null || seed_fail "conflicting or inherited lungs disk attachment"

    seed_lungs_profile_validate
    for disk_path in $(printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -r '.expanded_devices[] | .path'); do

seed_instance() {
    native=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$seed_name")
    seed_lungs_profile_expected
    printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -e --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --argjson running "$seed_allow_running" '
        .name == $name and .type == "container" and (.status == "Stopped" or ($running and .status == "Running")) and
        .config["user.opdbus.session_id"] == $sid and
        .config["boot.autostart"] == "false" and
        (.expanded_config["security.privileged"] // "false") == "false" and
        (.expanded_config["security.nesting"] // "false") == "false" and
        (.expanded_devices | type == "object" and length > 0 and all(.[]; .type == "disk")) and
        .devices.root.type == "disk" and .devices.root.path == "/" and
        .expanded_devices.root == .devices.root and
        (.config["volatile.uuid"] | type == "string" and length > 0)

    seed_lungs_profile_validate
    printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -e '
        .expanded_config as $c |
        ($c["raw.seccomp"] // "") == "" and
        ($c["raw.idmap"] // "") == "" and
        ($c["security.syscalls.allow"] // "") == "" and
        ($c["security.syscalls.whitelist"] // "") == "" and
        ($c["security.syscalls.deny_default"] // $c["security.syscalls.blacklist_default"] // "true") == "true" and
        (($c["security.syscalls.deny"] // $c["security.syscalls.blacklist"] // "" | split("\n")) as $rules |
            all([
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x4008941a,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]",
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000940f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]",
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000943f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]"
            ][]; . as $rule | $rules | index($rule) != null))
    ' >/dev/null || seed_fail "candidate lacks required Btrfs mutation deny policy or overrides default seccomp"

    valid_session "$native_uuid" || seed_fail "invalid native instance UUID"
    native_pool=$(printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -er '.devices.root.pool')
    printf '%s' "$native_pool" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe pool name"
    pool_record=$(incus query "/1.0/storage-pools/$native_pool")
    printf '%s\n' "$pool_record" | jq -e --arg pool "$native_pool" '
        .name == $pool and .driver == "dir" and .status == "Created"
    ' >/dev/null || seed_fail "candidate needs an existing dir pool"
    native_state=${OP_IDENTITY_INCUS_STATE_DIR:-/var/lib/incus}
    pool_source=$(printf '%s\n' "$pool_record" | jq -er '.config.source')
    seed_secure_path "$pool_source"
    [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$native_state/storage-pools/$native_pool")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$pool_source")" ] || seed_fail "native pool mount does not match the reported source"

}
seed_write() {
    # All parents are private/root-controlled; exclusive staging plus rename

    ( set -C; : > "$seed_dir/state.tmp" ) || seed_fail "stale descriptor staging file"
    jq "$@" "$seed_dir/state.json" > "$seed_dir/state.tmp"
    chmod 600 "$seed_dir/state.tmp"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.tmp"
    mv -- "$seed_dir/state.tmp" "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
}
seed_read() {
    seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/state.json"

    [ "$(stat -c %s "$seed_dir/state.json")" -le 16384 ] || seed_fail "oversized descriptor"
    jq -e --arg name "$seed_name" '
        .version == 1 and .layout == "shared-partition-siblings-v2" and .name == $name and .phase == "ready" and
        (keys | sort) == (["version","layout","image","members","persist","name","session","phase","seed_fsid","seed_generation","leaf","leaf_inode","leaf_size","sprout_fsid","instance_uuid","root","seed_loop","leaf_loop","boot_id"] | sort)
    ' "$seed_dir/state.json" >/dev/null || seed_fail "creation incomplete or descriptor invalid; inspect retained intent"
    seed_session=$(jq -er '.session' "$seed_dir/state.json")
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "invalid session binding"
    leaf=$(jq -er '.leaf' "$seed_dir/state.json")
    seed_secure_path "$leaf"
    [ -f "$leaf" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a "$leaf")" = 600 ] || seed_fail "unsafe leaf"
    [ "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" = "$(jq -er '.leaf_inode' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %s "$leaf")" = "$(jq -er '.leaf_size' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "leaf backing changed"
    [ "$source_fsid" = "$(jq -er '.seed_fsid' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] &&
        [ "$source_generation" = "$(jq -er '.seed_generation' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "seed changed"
    sprout_fsid=$(jq -er '.sprout_fsid' "$seed_dir/state.json")
    [ "$(seed_super "$leaf")" = "$sprout_fsid" ] || seed_fail "leaf FSID changed"
    seed_view=$(jq -r '.seed_loop' "$seed_dir/state.json")
    leaf_loop=$(jq -r '.leaf_loop' "$seed_dir/state.json")
    recorded_boot=$(jq -er '.boot_id' "$seed_dir/state.json")

    seed_verify_boot_marker
}
seed_boot_selection() {
    jq --argjson start "$1" '{version,layout,image,members,persist,name,session,instance_uuid,root,seed_fsid,seed_generation,sprout_fsid,leaf,leaf_inode,leaf_size,start_on_boot:$start}' "$seed_dir/state.json"
}
seed_boot_name() {
    [ "$seed_name" = "$seed_session" ] || {

            [ "$seed_session" = b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28 ]

seed_verify_boot_marker() {
    [ -e "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json" ] || [ -L "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json" ] || return 0

    [ -f "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json")" = 600 ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %s "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json")" -le 8192 ] || seed_fail "unsafe boot completion marker"

    marker_policy=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot | select(type == "boolean") | tostring' "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json")

seed_enable_boot() {
    boot_policy=$1

    seed_lungs_paths
    seed_lungs_verify

        seed_verify_boot_marker

    ( set -C; seed_boot_selection "$boot_policy" > "$seed_dir/boot-ready.tmp" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/boot-ready.tmp"
    ln -- "$seed_dir/boot-ready.tmp" "$seed_dir/boot-ready.json"
    rm -- "$seed_dir/boot-ready.tmp"

}
seed_load() {
    seed_read

        [ "$native_root" = "$(jq -er '.root' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "native instance or root binding changed"

            [ -z "$(losetup -j "$leaf" -n -O NAME)" ] || seed_fail "unexpected active leaf across boot boundary"
