seed_rename() {
    new_name=$1
    seed_read
    [ "$new_name" = "$seed_session" ] && valid_session "$new_name" || seed_fail "new name must be the pinned canonical session UUID"
    old_name=$seed_name old_dir=$seed_dir
    old_root=$(jq -er '.root' "$old_dir/state.json")
    old_uuid=$(jq -er '.instance_uuid' "$old_dir/state.json")
    [ -z "$seed_view" ] && [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] &&
        ! mountpoint -q "$old_dir/volume" && ! mountpoint -q "$old_root" &&
        [ -z "$(losetup -j "$leaf" -n -O NAME)" ] || seed_fail "rename requires completed seed-down with no mounts or mappings"
    seed_name=$new_name
    seed_instance
    [ "$native_uuid" = "$old_uuid" ] || seed_fail "renamed native instance UUID changed"
    [ "$old_root" = "$native_state/storage-pools/$native_pool/containers/$old_name/rootfs" ] || seed_fail "renamed native pool or old root binding changed"
    ! mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "renamed native root is mounted"

    flock -n 8 || seed_fail "destination lifecycle already owned"
    mkdir -- "$new_dir/volume"
    if [ -e "$old_dir/lungs-hook" ]; then
        seed_verify_lungs_hook
        ( set -C; cat "$old_dir/lungs-hook" > "$new_dir/lungs-hook" )
        sync -f "$new_dir/lungs-hook"
    fi
    if [ -e "$old_dir/lungs-disk.json" ]; then
        seed_verify_lungs_hook
        ( set -C; cat "$old_dir/lungs-disk.json" > "$new_dir/lungs-disk.json" )
        sync -f "$new_dir/lungs-disk.json"
    fi
    ( set -C; jq --arg name "$new_name" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" \
        '.name=$name | .root=$root | .boot_id=$boot' "$old_dir/state.json" > "$new_dir/state.tmp" )
    chmod 600 "$new_dir/state.tmp"
    sync -f "$new_dir/state.tmp"
    # Hard-link publication is atomic and fails if a receipt already exists.
    # On any failure retain old receipt plus new staging for operator review.
    ln -- "$new_dir/state.tmp" "$new_dir/state.json"
    rm -- "$new_dir/state.tmp"
    sync -f "$new_dir"
    sync -f "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$old_dir

}
seed_verify_loop() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eq '^/dev/loop[0-9]+$' || seed_fail "invalid loop receipt"

        [ "$(losetup -n -O RO "$1")" = "$3" ] || seed_fail "loop no longer belongs to this descriptor: $1"
    case "$3" in 1) loop_ref=seed:$native_uuid ;; 0) loop_ref=leaf:$native_uuid ;; esac

}
seed_record_loops() {
    seed_write --arg seed "$seed_view" --arg leaf "$leaf_loop" '.seed_loop=$seed | .leaf_loop=$leaf'
}
seed_lungs_paths() {

}
seed_lungs_verify() {

        [ "$(stat -c %s "$lungs_private/mount.json")" -le 8192 ] || seed_fail "unsafe lungs process receipt"

        .boot_id == $boot and .session == $session and .target == $target and
        (.pid | type == "number" and . > 1 and floor == .) and
        (.start | type == "string") and (.args | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")) and
        .args == [.args[0],"--store",$store,"mount","--allow-other","--auto-unmount","--state",$state,"--lungs-socket","/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock","--lungs-session",$session,$target]

    seed_secure_path "$receipt_binary"

content.text:
[ "$(readlink -f "/proc/$lungs_pid/exe")" = "$receipt_binary" ] || seed_fail "lungs daemon executable changed"

    [ "$process_args" = "$(jq -c '.args' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "lungs daemon arguments changed"
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o FSTYPE)" = fuse.3tchedFS ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o SOURCE)" = 3tchedFS ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o ID)" = "$(jq -er '.mount_id' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "unexpected lungs mount"

seed_lungs() {
    seed_lungs_paths

    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -r '.status')" = Stopped ] || seed_fail "lungs spawn requires stopped instance"
    [ ! -e "$lungs_private/mount.json" ] && [ ! -L "$lungs_private/mount.json" ] || seed_fail "stale lungs receipt; inspect before retry"
    [ -z "$(find "$lungs_target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "guest lungs directory is not empty"
    lungs_binary=$(readlink -f -- "$THREETCHED_FS")
    seed_secure_path "$lungs_binary"
    [ -f "$lungs_binary" ] && [ -x "$lungs_binary" ] || seed_fail "missing host 3tchedFS executable"
    lungs_catalog=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_CATALOG:-/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs}
    seed_secure_path "$lungs_catalog"
    seed_private_dir "$lungs_private/store"
    seed_private_dir "$lungs_private/empty-state"

        "$lungs_target" 8>&- 9>&- </dev/null > "$lungs_private/mount.log" 2>&1 &

    i=0

        sleep 0.1
    done
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg boot "$boot_id" --arg session "$seed_session" --arg target "$lungs_target" --argjson pid "$lungs_pid" \
        --arg start "$(sed 's/^.*) //' "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" | awk '{print $20}')" \
        --argjson args "$(jq -Rsc 'split("\u0000")[:-1]' "/proc/$lungs_pid/cmdline")" --arg mount "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o ID)" \

seed_unlungs() {

seed_attach() {

    # Cross-boot receipts are cleared only by seed_load's verified cold gate.

        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
    else

        seed_view=$(losetup --find --show --read-only --loop-ref "seed:$native_uuid" "$seed_device")

        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
    else

        leaf_loop=$(losetup --find --show --loop-ref "leaf:$native_uuid" "$leaf")

seed_verify_volume() {
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$seed_dir/volume" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&

        [ "$(seed_super "$leaf_loop")" = "$sprout_fsid" ] || seed_fail "unexpected sprout mount"

    printf '%s\n' "$members" | grep -q "uuid: $sprout_fsid" || seed_fail "mounted FSID differs"

seed_member_pin() {

    pin_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "Subvolume" && $2 == "ID:" {print $3}')
    pin_uuid=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "UUID:" {print $2}')
    printf '%s' "$pin_id" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' && [ "$pin_id" -gt 5 ] && valid_session "$pin_uuid" || seed_fail "invalid sibling subvolume identity"

seed_layout_pins() {

    actual_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' "$subvolume_listing" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    expected_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user | LC_ALL=C sort)

        pin=$(seed_member_pin "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling") || seed_fail "cannot pin sibling: $sibling"

seed_persist_pin() {

    seed_profile
    ;;

    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
    seed_preflight
    ;;

    seed_inspect "$1"
    ;;

    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }

    ;;

    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
    ;;

    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)

    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "no legacy identity roots to restore"; exit 0; }
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    failed=0
    for session in "$@"; do

    done

    exit 0

    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
    ;;

    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] || { log "name the session to create"; exit 2; }
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
    ;;
*)
    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh
# build-golden.sh — prepare the golden btrfs subvolume from one release build.
#
# Populate the `golden` btrfs subvolume with the complete deployable content.
# Taking a read-only snapshot, transferring it with `btrfs send/receive`, and
# activating the received filesystem belong to the deployment process. This
# preparation script performs none of those deployment steps and never writes
# into the running host's installation or restarts a service.
#
# Layout created under $OPDBUS_ROOT (default /opt/op-dbus):
#
#   golden/                      the deployable subvolume
#     bin/                       release binaries
#     libexec/3tched/             application and explicit provisioning helpers/assets
#     usr/bin/threetched          pinned threetched dependency
#     usr/share/op-dbus/          immutable config, catalog and provenance
#     usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard/  pinned production UI assets at root
#     sv/<service>/run            enabled application runit definitions
#     opt/                       immutable broker and provider runtimes
# Host secrets, grants, network/bootstrap services and writable data are excluded.
#     MANIFEST                   commit, build time, sha256 per binary
#
# Usage:
#   build-golden.sh                 # prepare and validate golden (default)
#   build-golden.sh --golden-only   # compatibility alias for the default
#   build-golden.sh --dry-run
#
# Retired options `--live-only` and `--no-restart` fail explicitly. Requires
# root to populate the btrfs subvolume. Never builds: run
# `CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release` first (the
# vendored RocksDB in cozorocks needs that flag on modern GCC).
# `OP_PERSISTED_CATALOG_SOURCE` may name an isolated prepared catalog; it
# defaults to `/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs` and is never modified here.
# `OP_RELEASE_DIR` selects the same prepared optimized artifact directory as
# activate-golden.sh; it defaults to the workspace's target/release.
set -eu

OPDBUS_ROOT=${OPDBUS_ROOT:-/opt/op-dbus}
OPDBUS_ROOT=$(realpath -e -- "$OPDBUS_ROOT")
GOLDEN_DIR="$OPDBUS_ROOT/golden"

DRY_RUN=0

SCRIPT_PATH=$(readlink -f "$0" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$0")
# Internal helper of ./activate-golden.sh; every relative input lives in deploy/runit.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$SCRIPT_PATH")/../../runit" && pwd)
if [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../Cargo.toml" ]; then
    PROJECT_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
else
    PROJECT_ROOT=${OP_DBUS_ROOT:-$(pwd)}
fi
RELEASE_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_RELEASE_DIR:-"$PROJECT_ROOT/target/release"}")
MCP_AUDIENCE_POLICY_SOURCE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/mcp-audience-policy.json"
HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/host-runtime-packages.txt"
PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR=${OP_PERSISTED_CATALOG_SOURCE:-/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs}
PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR")
case "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR" in
    "$GOLDEN_DIR"|"$GOLDEN_DIR"/*)
        printf '%s\n' "catalog source must be outside the golden preparation tree" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
RETIRED_SERVICES_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/retired-services"
RETIRED_BINARIES_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/retired-binaries"
EMQX_VERSION_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/emqx.version"
EMQX_CONFIG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/../emqx"
EMQX_ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR=${EMQX_ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR:-/var/cache/op-dbus/source-artifacts}
MCP_PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR=${MCP_PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR:-/var/cache/op-dbus/source-artifacts}
NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_VERSION_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/notebooklm-mcp.version"
EXECUTION_PYTHON_LOCK="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/execution-python-requirements.lock"
EXECUTION_PYTHON_PREPARE="$SCRIPT_DIR/prepare-execution-python.sh"
NLM_CLI_ROOT=/opt/opdbus
TCHED_ROUTER_SOURCE_PIN="$PROJECT_ROOT/vendor/tched-router/source.pin"
TCHED_ROUTER_VENDORED_SOURCE="$PROJECT_ROOT/vendor/tched-router/source.tar.gz"
TCHED_ROUTER_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/target/threetched-artifacts/tched-router"
THREETCHED_BIN="$TCHED_ROUTER_ARTIFACT_DIR/threetched"
THREETCHED_MANIFEST="$TCHED_ROUTER_ARTIFACT_DIR/manifest.json"
TCHED_ROUTER_LAG_PATCH="$PROJECT_ROOT/vendor/tched-router/patches/0001-close-threetched-event-stream-on-lag.patch"

        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then

        else

            python3 -m venv "$nlm_stage" || die "python3 -m venv failed; retained $nlm_stage"

                die "nlm entry point validation failed; retained $nlm_stage"
            printf '%s\n' "$NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_SHA256" > "$nlm_stage/.opdbus-artifact-sha256"
            chmod 0755 "$nlm_stage"
            mv -T -- "$nlm_stage" "$venv"

     .upstream.tag == $tag and
     .upstream.commit == $commit and
     .upstream.source_archive_sha256 == $source_sha and
     .upstream.vendored_source_gzip_sha256 == $vendored_source_gzip_sha and
     .artifact.name == "threetched" and
     .artifact.sha256 == $binary_sha and
     .artifact.bytes == $binary_bytes and
     (.artifact.rust_target | type == "string" and length > 0) and
     .patches.lagged_sse_sha256 == $lag_patch_sha and
     .patches.stateless_generation_sha256 == $generation_patch_sha and
     .patches.branding_sha256 == $branding_patch_sha and
     .patches.inventory_sha256 == $inventory_sha and
     .patches.base_manifest_sha256 == $base_manifest_sha and
     (.patches.patched_cargo_lock_sha256 | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$"))' \
    "$THREETCHED_MANIFEST" >/dev/null ||
    die "threetched provenance does not match its pinned source and binary"
[ "$("$THREETCHED_BIN" --version)" = "threetched ${UPSTREAM_TAG#v}" ] ||
    die "threetched candidate reports an unexpected version"
strings "$THREETCHED_BIN" | grep -Fq 'tched_router.generation.v1' ||

[ -f "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG" ] ||

[ -z "$(find "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS" -type l -print -quit)" ] ||
    die "tched_router bootstrap skill bundle must not contain symlinks"
[REDACTED:opaque-base64]$(find "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS" -type f | wc -l)
[ "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILL_COUNT" -gt 0 ] ||
    die "tched_router bootstrap skill bundle is empty"
[ -f "$AGENT_BUNDLE_SOURCE/AGENTS.md" ] ||

[ -z "$(find "$AGENT_BUNDLE_SOURCE" ! -type f ! -type d -print -quit)" ] ||
    die "shared agent bundle must contain only regular files and directories"
[REDACTED:opaque-base64]$(sha256sum "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG" | cut -d' ' -f1)
[REDACTED:opaque-base64]$(
    find "$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS" -type f -print | sort |
        while IFS= read -r skill; do
            relative=${skill#"$TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS"/}
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "$skill" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$relative"
        done | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
)
[ -x "$UI_ASSET_BUILD_HELPER" ] || die "missing pinned UI asset builder: $UI_ASSET_BUILD_HELPER"
[ -f "$UI_SOURCE_PIN" ] && [ -f "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE" ] && [ -f "$UI_SOURCE_MANIFEST" ] ||
    die "pinned UI source archive, pin, or content manifest is missing under $UI_SOURCE_DIR"
[ -f "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" ] && [ -f "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST" ] || die "missing pinned UI asset artifact; build it with:
  $UI_ASSET_BUILD_HELPER --npm-cache /var/cache/op-dbus-build/npm --output-dir $UI_ARTIFACT_DIR"

ui_pin() {
    key=$1
    sed -n "s/^${key}=//p" "$UI_SOURCE_PIN"
}
UI_PIN_FORMAT=$(ui_pin format)
UI_PIN_HEAD=$(ui_pin source_head)
UI_PIN_WORKTREE=$(ui_pin source_worktree)
UI_PIN_ARCHIVE_SHA256=$(ui_pin source_archive_sha256)
UI_PIN_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256=$(ui_pin content_manifest_sha256)
UI_PIN_ASSET_BASE=$(ui_pin asset_base)
UI_PIN_DOOR=$(ui_pin door_default)
[ "$UI_PIN_FORMAT" = opdbus.3tched-json-render-ui-source.v1 ] || die "unsupported pinned UI source format: $UI_PIN_FORMAT"
case "$UI_PIN_HEAD" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') die "invalid pinned UI source revision" ;; esac
[ "${#UI_PIN_HEAD}" -eq 40 ] || die "pinned UI source revision must contain 40 lowercase hex characters"
case "$UI_PIN_WORKTREE" in clean|modified) ;; *) die "invalid pinned UI worktree state" ;; esac
[ "$UI_PIN_ASSET_BASE" = / ] || die "pinned UI asset base must be the dashboard root"
[ -n "$UI_PIN_DOOR" ] || die "pinned UI production door is empty"
case "$UI_PIN_ARCHIVE_SHA256" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') die "invalid pinned UI archive digest" ;; esac
[ "${#UI_PIN_ARCHIVE_SHA256}" -eq 64 ] || die "pinned UI archive digest must contain 64 lowercase hex characters"
case "$UI_PIN_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') die "invalid pinned UI content manifest digest" ;; esac
[ "${#UI_PIN_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256}" -eq 64 ] || die "pinned UI content manifest digest must contain 64 lowercase hex characters"
[ "$(sha256sum "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$UI_PIN_ARCHIVE_SHA256" ] ||
    die "pinned UI source archive does not match source.pin"
[ "$(sha256sum "$UI_SOURCE_MANIFEST" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$UI_PIN_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256" ] ||
    die "pinned UI source manifest does not match source.pin"
tar -tzf "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE" | awk '
    /^\// || /(^|\/)\.\.($|\/)/ { bad=1 }
    !/^3tched-json-render-ui\// { bad=1 }
    END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }
' || die "pinned UI source archive contains an unsafe or unexpected path"
tar -tzf "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE" | grep -qx '3tched-json-render-ui/package-lock.json' ||
    die "pinned UI source archive is missing package-lock.json"
"$UI_ASSET_BUILD_HELPER" --verify-only || die "pinned UI source archive failed verification"

UI_SOURCE_HEAD=$(jq -er 'select(.format == "opdbus.3tched-json-render-ui-assets.v1") | .source.head | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest has an invalid format or source head"
UI_SOURCE_WORKTREE=$(jq -er '.source.worktree | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing source worktree provenance"
UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256=$(jq -er '.source.archive_sha256 | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing source archive provenance"
[REDACTED:opaque-base64]$(jq -er '.source.content_manifest_sha256 | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing source content manifest provenance"
UI_SOURCE_CONTENT_SHA256=$(jq -er '.source.package_lock_sha256 | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing package-lock provenance"
UI_PIN_PACKAGE_LOCK_SHA256=$(tar -xOzf "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE" 3tched-json-render-ui/package-lock.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
UI_ASSET_DOOR=$(jq -er '.build.door | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing the production door"
UI_ASSET_BASE=$(jq -er '.build.base | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing the UI asset base"
UI_ASSET_SHA256=$(jq -er '.artifact.sha256 | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing the artifact digest"
UI_ASSET_BYTES=$(jq -er '.artifact.bytes | numbers' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing the artifact size"
UI_ASSET_NAME=$(jq -er '.artifact.name | strings' "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST") ||
    die "UI asset manifest is missing the artifact name"
[ "$UI_SOURCE_HEAD" = "$UI_PIN_HEAD" ] && [ "$UI_SOURCE_WORKTREE" = "$UI_PIN_WORKTREE" ] ||
    die "UI asset manifest source revision does not match source.pin"
[ "$UI_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256" = "$UI_PIN_ARCHIVE_SHA256" ] ||
    die "UI asset manifest source archive digest does not match source.pin"
[ "$UI_SOURCE_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256" = "$UI_PIN_CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256" ] ||
    die "UI asset manifest content manifest digest does not match source.pin"
[ "$UI_SOURCE_CONTENT_SHA256" = "$UI_PIN_PACKAGE_LOCK_SHA256" ] ||
    die "UI asset manifest package-lock digest does not match the pinned source archive"

content.text:
[ "$UI_ASSET_BASE" = "$UI_PIN_ASSET_BASE" ] && [ "$UI_ASSET_BASE" = / ] ||
    die "UI asset manifest base does not match the pinned dashboard root"
[ "$UI_ASSET_DOOR" = "$UI_PIN_DOOR" ] || die "UI asset manifest door does not match source.pin"
[ "$UI_ASSET_NAME" = assets.tar.gz ] || die "UI asset manifest names an unexpected artifact"
case "$UI_ASSET_SHA256" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') die "invalid UI asset digest in manifest" ;; esac
[ "${#UI_ASSET_SHA256}" -eq 64 ] || die "UI asset digest must contain 64 lowercase hex characters"
[ "$(sha256sum "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$UI_ASSET_SHA256" ] ||
    die "UI asset archive does not match its provenance manifest"
[ "$(wc -c < "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" | tr -d ' ')" = "$UI_ASSET_BYTES" ] ||
    die "UI asset archive size does not match its provenance manifest"
UI_ASSET_MANIFEST_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST" | cut -d' ' -f1)
tar -tzf "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" | awk '
    /^\// || /(^|\/)\.\.($|\/)/ { bad=1 }
    END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }
' || die "UI asset archive contains an unsafe path"
tar -tvzf "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" | awk 'substr($1,1,1) !~ /[-d]/ {bad=1} END {exit bad ? 1 : 0}' ||
    die "UI asset archive must contain only files and directories"
tar -tzf "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" | grep -qx './index.html' ||
    die "UI asset archive is missing index.html"
[ -f "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" ] ||
    die "missing persisted sealed catalog; run the freshly built opblob seal-shm and persist preparation steps first"
jq -e '
    (.generation | type == "number" and floor == . and . >= 1) and
    (.catalog_hash | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")) and
    (.plugins | type == "object" and length > 0) and
    all(.plugins | to_entries[];
        (.key | test("^[a-z0-9_-]+$")) and
        (.value | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")))
' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" >/dev/null ||
    die "persisted sealed catalog manifest is invalid"
jq -e '.plugins.threetched | type == "string"' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" >/dev/null ||
    die "persisted sealed catalog is missing threetched; seal its selected capture inputs with opblob first"
CATALOG_GENERATION=$(jq -r '.generation' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json")
CATALOG_HASH=$(jq -r '.catalog_hash' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json")
CATALOG_MANIFEST_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)
CATALOG_PLUGIN_COUNT=$(jq -r '.plugins | length' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json")
ACTUAL_CATALOG_BLOB_COUNT=$(find "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.blob' | wc -l)
[ "$ACTUAL_CATALOG_BLOB_COUNT" -eq "$CATALOG_PLUGIN_COUNT" ] ||
    die "persisted sealed catalog blob count does not match its manifest"
jq -r '.plugins | to_entries[] | [.key, .value] | @tsv' \
    "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" |
    while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r plugin_id schema_hash; do
        blob="$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/$plugin_id.$(printf '%s' "$schema_hash" | cut -c1-16).blob"
        [ -f "$blob" ] || die "persisted sealed catalog is missing $blob"
        inspected=$("$RELEASE_DIR/opblob" inspect "$blob") ||
            die "persisted sealed catalog contains an invalid blob: $blob"
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$inspected" | awk '$1 == "plugin" { print $2; exit }')" = "$plugin_id" ] ||
            die "persisted sealed catalog blob plugin id does not match its manifest: $blob"
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$inspected" | awk '$1 == "schema" && $2 == "sha256" { print $3; exit }')" = "$schema_hash" ] ||
            die "persisted sealed catalog blob schema hash does not match its manifest: $blob"
        if [ "$plugin_id" = threetched ]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$inspected" | awk '$1 == "method" {found=1} END {exit found ? 0 : 1}' ||
                die "sealed threetched blob has no method inventory"
            printf '%s\n' "$inspected" | awk '$1 == "descriptor" && /services=\["/ {found=1} END {exit found ? 0 : 1}' ||
                die "sealed threetched blob has no method service descriptor"
        fi
    done
# Use the existing schema projection to inspect the sealed plugin example.
# This only reads the supplied catalog into a disposable declaration-only view;
# opblob remains the sole sealer and the backing binary is never recaptured here.
(
    threetched_validation=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/threetched-release-catalog.XXXXXX") || exit 1
    trap 'rm -rf -- "$threetched_validation"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    mkdir "$threetched_validation/state" || exit 1
    "$RELEASE_DIR/3tched-fs" --store "$threetched_validation/store" capture --schema-only \
        --catalog "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR" --state "$threetched_validation/state" >/dev/null || exit 1
    "$RELEASE_DIR/3tched-fs" --store "$threetched_validation/store" inspect --plugin threetched |
        jq -e --arg binary_sha "$THREETCHED_SHA256" --arg manifest_sha "$TCHED_ROUTER_MANIFEST_SHA256" '
            .plugin_id == "threetched" and .schema.name == "threetched" and
            (.schema.methods | type == "object" and length > 0) and
            .schema.example.binary == "/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/threetched/threetched" and
            .schema.example.manifest == "/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-manifests/tched-router.json" and
            .schema.example.binary_sha256 == $binary_sha and
            .schema.example.manifest_sha256 == $manifest_sha
        ' >/dev/null
) || die "sealed threetched capture provenance does not match the prepared release binary and manifest"
[ -f "$EMQX_ARTIFACT_PATH" ] || die "missing pinned EMQX artifact: $EMQX_ARTIFACT_PATH"
[ "$(sha256sum "$EMQX_ARTIFACT_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$EMQX_SHA256" ] ||
    die "EMQX artifact digest does not match deploy/config/emqx.version"
tar -tzf "$EMQX_ARTIFACT_PATH" | awk '
    /^\// || /(^|\/)\.\.($|\/)/ { bad = 1 }
    END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }
' || die "EMQX artifact contains an unsafe path"
for required in bin/emqx etc/emqx.conf etc/base.hocon; do
    tar -tzf "$EMQX_ARTIFACT_PATH" | grep -qx "$required" ||
        die "EMQX artifact is missing $required"
done
for required_config in emqx.conf base.hocon acl.conf; do
    [ -f "$EMQX_CONFIG_DIR/$required_config" ] ||
        die "missing tracked EMQX config: $EMQX_CONFIG_DIR/$required_config"
done
[ -f "$NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_ARTIFACT_PATH" ] ||
    die "missing pinned jacob-bd nlm wheel: $NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_ARTIFACT_PATH"
[ "$(sha256sum "$NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_ARTIFACT_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_SHA256" ] ||
    die "nlm wheel digest does not match deploy/config/notebooklm-mcp.version"
python3 - "$NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_ARTIFACT_PATH" <<'PY' ||
import sys, zipfile
wheel = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1])
names = wheel.namelist()
if any(n.startswith("/") or "/../" in n or n.startswith("../") for n in names):
    raise SystemExit("unsafe path in nlm wheel")
if not any(n.endswith("entry_points.txt") for n in names):
    raise SystemExit("nlm wheel is missing entry_points.txt")
text = wheel.read(next(n for n in names if n.endswith("entry_points.txt"))).decode()
if "nlm =" not in text and "nlm=" not in text:
    raise SystemExit("nlm wheel does not declare the nlm console script")
PY
    die "pinned nlm wheel failed integrity checks"

[ -x "$RELEASE_DIR/op-grants-materializer" ] ||
    die "release is missing op-grants-materializer"
"$RELEASE_DIR/op-grants-materializer" validate-audience "$MCP_AUDIENCE_POLICY_SOURCE" >/dev/null ||
    die "MCP audience policy is invalid"
[ -r "$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE" ] ||
    die "missing host runtime package manifest: $HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE"
HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES=$(grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE")
[ -n "$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES" ] || die "host runtime package manifest is empty"
[ -r "$EXECUTION_PYTHON_LOCK" ] || die "missing execution Python requirements lock"
[ -x "$EXECUTION_PYTHON_PREPARE" ] || die "execution Python preparation helper is not executable"
EXECUTION_PYTHON_LOCK_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$EXECUTION_PYTHON_LOCK" | cut -d' ' -f1)
HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CHECK="$SCRIPT_DIR/check-host-runtime-packages.sh"
[ -x "$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CHECK" ] || die "missing host runtime package checker: $HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CHECK"
if ! missing_host_packages=$("$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CHECK" "$HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE"); then
    die "host runtime package verification failed: $(printf '%s' "$missing_host_packages" | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi
BIN_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | wc -l)
log "$BIN_COUNT release binaries in $RELEASE_DIR"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ] && [ "$(id -u)" != 0 ]; then
    die "must run as root to prepare the golden btrfs subvolume"
fi

COMMIT=$(git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
STAMP=$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

# ═══ Path 1: golden subvolume ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
build_golden() {
    log "building golden subvolume at $GOLDEN_DIR"

    [ -d "$GOLDEN_DIR" ] && [ ! -L "$GOLDEN_DIR" ] ||
        die "golden must already exist; use op-release provision-slots"
    [ "$(stat -f -c %T "$GOLDEN_DIR")" = btrfs ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %i "$GOLDEN_DIR")" = 256 ] ||
        die "golden is not a Btrfs subvolume; use op-release provision-slots"
    [ "$(stat -c %u:%g "$GOLDEN_DIR")" = 0:0 ] ||
        die "golden must be root-owned"
    case "$(stat -c %a "$GOLDEN_DIR")" in 700|750|755) ;; *) die "unsafe golden root mode" ;; esac
    btrfs subvolume show "$GOLDEN_DIR" >/dev/null ||
        die "cannot inspect the provisioned golden subvolume"
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$GOLDEN_DIR" ro)" = ro=false ] ||
        die "golden must be writable preparation state"
    # Refuse nested filesystem ownership before any subtractive cutover.
    [ -z "$(find "$GOLDEN_DIR" -mindepth 1 -type d -inum 256 -print -quit)" ] ||
        die "golden contains a nested Btrfs subvolume"
    if findmnt -rn -o TARGET | awk -v root="$GOLDEN_DIR/" \
        'index($0, root) == 1 { found=1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }'; then
        die "golden contains a nested mount"
    fi

    ensure_directory "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin"
    ensure_directory "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv"
    ensure_directory "$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/share/op-dbus"

    # These were preparation-owned paths in the old root-shaped golden.
    # Never remove their live host counterparts or any unrecognized base files.
    for legacy in sbin/systemd-unit-to-runit sbin/op-convert-systemd-units \
        sbin/systemctl-shim sbin/ban-caddy-nginx sbin/build-golden.sh sbin/agent-runit-guard.sh \
        libexec/op-warp-ssh share/op-dbus/warp-ssh \
        share/op-dbus/notebook-sync var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs \
        etc/environment.default etc/pacman-hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook \
        etc/pacman-hooks/99-ban-caddy-nginx.hook etc/pacman-hooks/99-agent-runit-guard.hook \
        etc/opdbus/capability-grants.json etc/opdbus/mcp-audience-policy.json \
        etc/opdbus/mcp-toolsets.json etc/opdbus/host-runtime-packages.txt \
        etc/opdbus/enabled-services etc/opdbus/retired-services etc/opdbus/retired-binaries \
        etc/op-dbus/threetched-runtime.toml etc/op-dbus/model-providers.toml \
        etc/op-dbus/threetched-skills etc/op-dbus/opencode-runtime.json \
        etc/dbus-1/system.d/org.dbusmcp.conf etc/pam.d/op-dbus-elevate \
        etc/nftables.conf etc/iptables/iptables.rules etc/op-dbus/network.conf \
        etc/op-dbus/openflow-static-flows.json etc/ssh/sshd_config \
        etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-loopback-only.conf \
        etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/15-ghostbridge-vip.conf \
        etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-singleuser-password.conf etc/emqx \
        opt/op-mcp-providers opt/op-dbus/container-artifacts/mail-3tched-x86_64-linux-gnu-bundle.tar \
        usr/share/op-dbus/etc/opdbus/mcp-toolsets.json \
        usr/share/op-dbus/etc/op-dbus/model-providers.toml \
        usr/bin/opencode; do
        if [ -e "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy" ] || [ -L "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy" ]; then
            remove_owned "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy"
        fi
    done
    for legacy_root in etc var share sbin; do
        [ ! -d "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy_root" ] || {
            [ ! -L "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy_root" ] || die "symlink legacy root"
            if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
                find "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy_root" -depth -type d -empty -delete
                [ ! -e "$GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy_root" ] ||
                    die "unrecognized legacy content remains; preserved $GOLDEN_DIR/$legacy_root"
            fi
        }
    done
    # All binary entries here belonged to the prior release builder.
    find "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print | while IFS= read -r old; do
        [ "$(basename "$old")" = nlm ] && continue
        printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | grep -Fxq "$RELEASE_DIR/$(basename "$old")" ||
            run rm -- "$old"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        install_file 0755 "$bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin/$(basename "$bin")"
    done
    install_file 0755 "$THREETCHED_BIN" "$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/bin/threetched"
    install_file 0644 "$THREETCHED_MANIFEST" \
        "$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-manifests/tched-router.json"

    ui_destination="$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard"
    ui_manifest="$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/share/op-dbus/ui-manifests/3tched-ui.json"
    if [ ! -f "$ui_manifest" ] || ! cmp -s "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST" "$ui_manifest" ||
       [ ! -f "$ui_destination/index.html" ]; then
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
            log "would synchronize changed UI archive"
        else
            (
                ui_stage=$(mktemp -d)
                trap 'rm -rf -- "$ui_stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
                tar -xzf "$UI_ASSET_ARCHIVE" --no-same-owner -C "$ui_stage"
                sync_tree "$ui_stage" "$ui_destination"
            )
        fi
    fi
    install_file 0644 "$UI_ASSET_MANIFEST" "$ui_manifest"

    golden_catalog="$GOLDEN_DIR/usr/share/op-dbus/plugin-blobs"
    ensure_directory "$golden_catalog"
    find "$golden_catalog" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.blob' -print |
        while IFS= read -r old; do
            [ -f "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/$(basename "$old")" ] || run rm -- "$old"
        done
    jq -r '.plugins | to_entries[] | [.key, .value] | @tsv' "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" |
        while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r plugin_id schema_hash; do
            blob="$plugin_id.$(printf '%s' "$schema_hash" | cut -c1-16).blob"
            install_file 0644 "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/$blob" "$golden_catalog/$blob"
        done
    install_file 0644 "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR/.manifest.json" "$golden_catalog/.manifest.json"

    # One release-owned helper target. Only the explicit provisioning closure
    # above joins the existing application helpers; base service definitions,
    # host-installed helper copies, receipts and storage remain untouched.
    ensure_directory "$GOLDEN_DIR/libexec/3tched"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Invoke one plugin method through the supported same-handle mounted client.
# The mount must already be bound to the caller's identity
# (e.g. /run/mounts/3tchedFS + /run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock).
#
# Capability grants and op-grants-materializer are not exposed here; durable policy
# stays under /etc/opdbus/local/ with owner-approved deltas only.
#
# Usage:
#   deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh <plugin> <method> [json-args] [--confirm-side-effects]
#   OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT=/run/mounts/3tchedFS deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh tched_router config_get '{"path":"agents.dashboard.model_provider"}'
set -euo pipefail

die() { echo "3tchedfs-invoke: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

MOUNT="${OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT:-/run/mounts/3tchedFS}"
CLIENT="${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs}"
PLUGIN="${1:?plugin id}"
METHOD="${2:?method name}"
shift 2
ARGS='{}'
if [[ $# -gt 0 && $1 != --confirm-side-effects ]]; then ARGS=$1; shift; fi
options=()
if [[ ${1:-} == --confirm-side-effects ]]; then options+=(--confirm-side-effects); shift; fi
[[ $# == 0 ]] || die 'pass one JSON argument and optional --confirm-side-effects'
[[ $PLUGIN =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ && $METHOD =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ ]] || die 'unsafe plugin or method name'
[[ -x $CLIENT ]] || die "mounted client absent: $CLIENT"
if [[ -n ${OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION:-} ]]; then
  options+=(--expected-session "$OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION")
fi

[[ -f "$MOUNT/.3tchedfs.json" ]] || die "not a 3tchedFS root: $MOUNT"
case "$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE -T "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null || true)" in
  fuse|fuse.3tchedFS) ;;
  *) die "namespace is not a fuse 3tchedFS mount: $MOUNT" ;;
esac

OP="$MOUNT/plugins/$PLUGIN/operations/$METHOD"
[[ -d "$OP" ]] || die "operation absent: $PLUGIN/$METHOD"
[[ -f "$OP/input.schema.json" ]] || die "missing input schema: $OP"

if ! printf '%s' "$ARGS" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  die "json-args must be valid JSON"
fi

# invoke validates the sealed schema and pinned mount, fsyncs and reads the
# receipt on the same descriptor. Preserve its diagnostic and exit status;
# never retry an uncertain mutation or fall back to a different transport.
exec "$CLIENT" invoke --mount "$MOUNT" "${options[@]}" --args "$ARGS" \
  "plugins/$PLUGIN/operations/$METHOD/call"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Host maintenance: attach existing shared empty/default folders. No content,
# credentials, storage membership, or container start is changed here.
set -euo pipefail
die() { printf 'workspace folders: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $# == 1 && $1 =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$ ]] || die 'usage: CONTAINER'
container=$1
[[ $(id -u) == 0 ]] || die 'requires host root'
incus() { command timeout --kill-after=5s 30s incus --force-local --project default "$@"; }
safe_host_directory() {
    local path=$1 mode
    [[ -d $path && $(realpath -e -- "$path") == "$path" ]] || die 'host directory must exist at its canonical path'
    while :; do
        [[ ! -L $path && $(stat -c %u -- "$path") == 0 ]] || die 'host path must be root-owned without symlinks'
        mode=$(stat -c %a -- "$path")
        (( (8#$mode & 022) == 0 )) || die 'host path must not be writable by group or others'
        [[ $path == / ]] && break
        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
    done
}
for directory in /etc/3tched /etc/3tched/skills /etc/3tched/rules /etc/3tched/user /etc/3tched/shared /etc/3tched/soul /etc/3tched/memory; do
    safe_host_directory "$directory"
done
client=$(realpath -e -- "${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs}")
[[ -f $client && -x $client && $(stat -c %u "$client") == 0 ]] || die 'unsafe mounted client'
mode=$(stat -c %a "$client")
(( (8#$mode & 022) == 0 )) || die 'mounted client is writable by another owner'
safe_host_directory "$(dirname -- "$client")"
control_mount=${OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT:-/run/mounts/3tchedFS}
[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$control_mount" -o FSTYPE) == fuse.3tchedFS ]] || die 'identity-bound control mount required'
mount_id=$(findmnt -rn -M "$control_mount" -o ID)
mount_pin=$(timeout 10s jq -ce 'select(.format=="3tchedfs/1" and
    .mount_identity.kind=="host_session" and .mount_identity.session==.session_id)' \
    "$control_mount/.3tchedfs.json") || die 'invalid control mount metadata'
operator=${OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION:-$(jq -er .session_id <<<"$mount_pin")}
jq -e --arg sid "$operator" '.session_id==$sid' <<<"$mount_pin" >/dev/null || die 'operator session mismatch'
assert_mount() {
    local current
    current=$(timeout 10s jq -ce . "$control_mount/.3tchedfs.json") || die 'control namespace lost'
    [[ $current == "$mount_pin" && $(findmnt -rn -M "$control_mount" -o ID) == "$mount_id" ]] || die 'control namespace changed; reconcile before retry'
}
expected='{"type":"disk","source":"/etc/3tched","path":"/etc/3tched","readonly":"true","shift":"true"}'
observe() {
    assert_mount
    native=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container")
    assert_mount
    printf '%s\n' "$native" | jq -e --arg name "$container" --argjson expected "$expected" '
        .name==$name and .type=="container" and .status=="Stopped" and
        (.expanded_config["security.privileged"] // "false")=="false" and
        (.expanded_devices | type)=="object" and
        .devices.root.type=="disk" and .devices.root.path=="/" and
        .devices.root==.expanded_devices.root and

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Offline image preparation; never mounts, unseals or starts a guest/service.
set -euo pipefail
fail() { printf 'prepare-lungs-client: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $# == 2 && $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'usage (host root): TOP READ_ONLY_RELEASE'
top=$1 release=$2
[[ $top == /* && $(realpath -e "$top") == "$top" && $top != / ]] || fail 'noncanonical image top'
[[ $(realpath -e "$release") == "$release" ]] || fail 'noncanonical release path'
case "$release" in
    /opt/op-dbus/releases/*) release_kind=received-release ;;
    /opt/op-dbus/release-send/*) release_kind=source-snapshot ;;
    *) fail 'expected retained received release or native release-send snapshot' ;;
esac
parent=$release
while :; do
    [[ $(stat -c %u "$parent") == 0 ]] || fail 'release path is not root-owned'
    mode=$(stat -c %a "$parent")
    (( (8#$mode & 022) == 0 )) || fail 'release path is writable by another owner'
    [[ $parent == / ]] && break
    parent=$(dirname -- "$parent")
done
[[ $(btrfs property get "$release" ro) == ro=true ]] || fail 'release must be read-only'
[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$top" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs ]] || fail 'image top must be an existing Btrfs mount'
case ",$(findmnt -rn -M "$top" -o OPTIONS)," in *,rw,*) ;; *) fail 'image must already be in authorized writable maintenance' ;; esac
guest=$top/@
[[ -d $guest && ! -L $guest ]] || fail 'missing guest root'
assets=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
client=$release/bin/3tched-fs
catalog=$release/usr/share/op-dbus/plugin-blobs
[[ -f $client && ! -L $client && -x $client && -d $catalog && ! -L $catalog ]] || fail 'release client or sealed public catalog absent'
for asset in 3tchedfs.service threetchedfs.service 3tchedfs-mount-preflight 3tched-lungs.conf mount.fuse.3tchedFS 3tchedfs.fstab; do
    [[ -f $assets/$asset ]] || fail "guest mount asset is absent: $asset"
done
[[ -z $(find "$catalog" -type l -print -quit) ]] || fail 'sealed catalog contains a symlink'
for rel in usr usr/sbin usr/local usr/local/bin usr/local/libexec usr/local/libexec/3tched usr/lib usr/lib/systemd usr/lib/systemd/system usr/lib/tmpfiles.d etc etc/systemd etc/systemd/system etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants usr/share usr/share/op-dbus; do
    path=$guest/$rel
    if [[ ! -e $path && ! -L $path ]]; then mkdir -m 0755 "$path"; fi
    [[ -d $path && ! -L $path && $(stat -c %u "$path") == 0 ]] || fail "unsafe image directory: $rel"
done
store=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-view
upstream_store=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-view
empty=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-empty-state
guest_catalog=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-catalog
unit=$guest/usr/lib/systemd/system/3tchedfs.service
unit_link=$guest/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/3tchedfs.service
upstream_unit=$guest/usr/lib/systemd/system/threetchedfs.service
upstream_unit_link=$guest/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/threetchedfs.service
preflight=$guest/usr/local/libexec/3tched/3tchedfs-mount-preflight
socket_link_config=$guest/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/3tched-lungs.conf
mount_helper=$guest/usr/sbin/mount.fuse.3tchedFS
fstab=$guest/etc/fstab
[[ -f $fstab && ! -L $fstab && $(stat -c %u "$fstab") == 0 ]] || fail 'unsafe or absent guest fstab'
if findmnt --fstab --tab-file "$fstab" -rn -o TARGET | grep -iExq '/run/mount/(3tchedfs|threetched)'; then
    fail 'guest fstab already declares a FUSE view; inspect before replacing'
fi
[[ ! -e $store && ! -L $store && ! -e $empty && ! -L $empty && ! -e $guest_catalog && ! -L $guest_catalog ]] || fail 'lungs client view or catalog already prepared; inspect existing image'
[[ ! -e $upstream_store && ! -L $upstream_store ]] || fail 'threetched view already prepared; inspect existing image'
[[ ! -e $guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs && ! -L $guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs ]] || fail 'client already exists; inspect before replacing'
for path in "$unit" "$unit_link" "$upstream_unit" "$upstream_unit_link" "$preflight" "$socket_link_config" "$mount_helper"; do
    [[ ! -e $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "guest mount service already exists: $path"
done
install -m 0755 "$client" "$guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs"
install -d -m 0755 "$empty" "$store" "$upstream_store"
# Same selection as the host adapter; only declarations enter the seed, never
# live state or credentials. Both mounts write through the same lungs endpoint.
upstream_plugins=threetched,tched_router
"$client" --store "$store" capture --schema-only --catalog "$catalog" --state "$empty" \
    --exclude-plugin "$upstream_plugins"
"$client" --store "$upstream_store" capture --schema-only --catalog "$catalog" --state "$empty" \
    --include-plugin "$upstream_plugins"
cp -a -- "$catalog" "$guest_catalog"
find "$store" "$upstream_store" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
find "$store" "$upstream_store" -type f -exec chmod 0644 {} +
find "$guest_catalog" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
find "$guest_catalog" -type f -exec chmod 0644 {} +
[[ -z $(find "$empty" -mindepth 1 -print -quit) ]] || fail 'schema capture populated state unexpectedly'
cmp "$client" "$guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs"
cmp "$catalog/.manifest.json" "$guest_catalog/.manifest.json"
install -m 0755 "$assets/3tchedfs-mount-preflight" "$preflight"
install -m 0644 "$assets/3tchedfs.service" "$unit"
install -m 0644 "$assets/threetchedfs.service" "$upstream_unit"
install -m 0644 "$assets/3tched-lungs.conf" "$socket_link_config"
install -m 0755 "$assets/mount.fuse.3tchedFS" "$mount_helper"
printf '\n' >> "$fstab"
cat "$assets/3tchedfs.fstab" >> "$fstab"
ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/3tchedfs.service "$unit_link"
ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/threetchedfs.service "$upstream_unit_link"
jq -n --arg release "${release##*/}" --arg release_kind "$release_kind" \
    --arg client_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$client" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Offline image preparation; never mounts, unseals or starts a guest/service.
set -euo pipefail
fail() { printf 'prepare-lungs-client: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $# == 2 && $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'usage (host root): TOP READ_ONLY_RELEASE'
top=$1 release=$2
[[ $top == /* && $(realpath -e "$top") == "$top" && $top != / ]] || fail 'noncanonical image top'
[[ $(realpath -e "$release") == "$release" ]] || fail 'noncanonical release path'
case "$release" in
    /opt/op-dbus/releases/*) release_kind=received-release ;;
    /opt/op-dbus/release-send/*) release_kind=source-snapshot ;;
    *) fail 'expected retained received release or native release-send snapshot' ;;
esac
parent=$release
while :; do
    [[ $(stat -c %u "$parent") == 0 ]] || fail 'release path is not root-owned'
    mode=$(stat -c %a "$parent")
    (( (8#$mode & 022) == 0 )) || fail 'release path is writable by another owner'
    [[ $parent == / ]] && break
    parent=$(dirname -- "$parent")
done
[[ $(btrfs property get "$release" ro) == ro=true ]] || fail 'release must be read-only'
[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$top" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs ]] || fail 'image top must be an existing Btrfs mount'
case ",$(findmnt -rn -M "$top" -o OPTIONS)," in *,rw,*) ;; *) fail 'image must already be in authorized writable maintenance' ;; esac
guest=$top/@
[[ -d $guest && ! -L $guest ]] || fail 'missing guest root'
assets=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
client=$release/bin/3tched-fs
catalog=$release/usr/share/op-dbus/plugin-blobs
[[ -f $client && ! -L $client && -x $client && -d $catalog && ! -L $catalog ]] || fail 'release client or sealed public catalog absent'
for asset in 3tchedfs.service threetchedfs.service 3tchedfs-mount-preflight 3tched-lungs.conf mount.fuse.3tchedFS 3tchedfs.fstab; do
    [[ -f $assets/$asset ]] || fail "guest mount asset is absent: $asset"
done
[[ -z $(find "$catalog" -type l -print -quit) ]] || fail 'sealed catalog contains a symlink'
for rel in usr usr/sbin usr/local usr/local/bin usr/local/libexec usr/local/libexec/3tched usr/lib usr/lib/systemd usr/lib/systemd/system usr/lib/tmpfiles.d etc etc/systemd etc/systemd/system etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants usr/share usr/share/op-dbus; do
    path=$guest/$rel
    if [[ ! -e $path && ! -L $path ]]; then mkdir -m 0755 "$path"; fi
    [[ -d $path && ! -L $path && $(stat -c %u "$path") == 0 ]] || fail "unsafe image directory: $rel"
done
store=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-view
upstream_store=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-view
empty=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-empty-state
guest_catalog=$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-catalog
unit=$guest/usr/lib/systemd/system/3tchedfs.service
unit_link=$guest/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/3tchedfs.service
upstream_unit=$guest/usr/lib/systemd/system/threetchedfs.service
upstream_unit_link=$guest/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/threetchedfs.service
preflight=$guest/usr/local/libexec/3tched/3tchedfs-mount-preflight
socket_link_config=$guest/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/3tched-lungs.conf
mount_helper=$guest/usr/sbin/mount.fuse.3tchedFS
fstab=$guest/etc/fstab
[[ -f $fstab && ! -L $fstab && $(stat -c %u "$fstab") == 0 ]] || fail 'unsafe or absent guest fstab'
if findmnt --fstab --tab-file "$fstab" -rn -o TARGET | grep -iExq '/run/mount/(3tchedfs|threetched)'; then
    fail 'guest fstab already declares a FUSE view; inspect before replacing'
fi
[[ ! -e $store && ! -L $store && ! -e $empty && ! -L $empty && ! -e $guest_catalog && ! -L $guest_catalog ]] || fail 'lungs client view or catalog already prepared; inspect existing image'
[[ ! -e $upstream_store && ! -L $upstream_store ]] || fail 'threetched view already prepared; inspect existing image'
[[ ! -e $guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs && ! -L $guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs ]] || fail 'client already exists; inspect before replacing'
for path in "$unit" "$unit_link" "$upstream_unit" "$upstream_unit_link" "$preflight" "$socket_link_config" "$mount_helper"; do
    [[ ! -e $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "guest mount service already exists: $path"
done
install -m 0755 "$client" "$guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs"
install -d -m 0755 "$empty" "$store" "$upstream_store"
# Same selection as the host adapter; only declarations enter the seed, never
# live state or credentials. Both mounts write through the same lungs endpoint.
upstream_plugins=threetched,tched_router
"$client" --store "$store" capture --schema-only --catalog "$catalog" --state "$empty" \
    --exclude-plugin "$upstream_plugins"
"$client" --store "$upstream_store" capture --schema-only --catalog "$catalog" --state "$empty" \
    --include-plugin "$upstream_plugins"
cp -a -- "$catalog" "$guest_catalog"
find "$store" "$upstream_store" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
find "$store" "$upstream_store" -type f -exec chmod 0644 {} +
find "$guest_catalog" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
find "$guest_catalog" -type f -exec chmod 0644 {} +
[[ -z $(find "$empty" -mindepth 1 -print -quit) ]] || fail 'schema capture populated state unexpectedly'
cmp "$client" "$guest/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs"
cmp "$catalog/.manifest.json" "$guest_catalog/.manifest.json"
install -m 0755 "$assets/3tchedfs-mount-preflight" "$preflight"
install -m 0644 "$assets/3tchedfs.service" "$unit"
install -m 0644 "$assets/threetchedfs.service" "$upstream_unit"
install -m 0644 "$assets/3tched-lungs.conf" "$socket_link_config"
install -m 0755 "$assets/mount.fuse.3tchedFS" "$mount_helper"
printf '\n' >> "$fstab"
cat "$assets/3tchedfs.fstab" >> "$fstab"
ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/3tchedfs.service "$unit_link"
ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/threetchedfs.service "$upstream_unit_link"
jq -n --arg release "${release##*/}" --arg release_kind "$release_kind" \
    --arg client_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$client" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" \
    --arg catalog_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$catalog/.manifest.json" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" \
    '{release:$release,release_kind:$release_kind,client_sha256:$client_sha256,catalog_manifest_sha256:$catalog_sha256,
      socket:"/run/3tched-lungs.socket",binding:"BindCurrentContainer",state:"empty",
      mounts:[{service:"3tchedfs.service",mountpoint:"/run/mount/3tchedfs",store:"/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-view"},
              {service:"threetchedfs.service",mountpoint:"/run/mount/threetched",store:"/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-view"}],
      mount_table:"/etc/fstab",

       "/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-empty-state","--lungs-socket","/run/3tched-lungs.socket","--all"]}' \
    > "$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-client.json"
chmod 0644 "$guest/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-client.json"

#!/bin/sh
# The guest owns two 3tchedFS mounts (3tchedfs, threetched); a host disk at either path is drift.
mountpoint=${1:-/run/mount/3tchedfs}
store=${2:-/usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-view}
set -eu
fail() { printf '3tchedfs-mount-preflight: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail 'mount owner must be root'
[ -c /dev/fuse ] || fail 'missing /dev/fuse'
[ -S /run/3tched-lungs.socket ] || fail 'missing runtime lungs socket'
[ -f /usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-catalog/.manifest.json ] || fail 'missing sealed catalog'
[ -d "$store/objects" ] || fail 'missing schema-only view'
[ -d /usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-empty-state ] || fail 'missing empty state directory'
# Incus's tmpfs starts with 1777 independently of the underlying /run mode.
# Normalize only the known guest-owned tmpfs; refuse every unexpected shape.
[ "$(findmnt -rn -M /run -o FSTYPE)" = tmpfs ] || exit 1
[ "$(stat -c '%u:%g' -- /run)" = 0:0 ] || exit 1
case "$(stat -c %a -- /run)" in
    1777) chmod 0755 /run ;;
    755) ;;
    *) exit 1 ;;
esac
for path in /run /run/mount "$mountpoint"; do
    if [ -e "$path" ] || [ -L "$path" ]; then
        [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] || exit 1
    else
        mkdir -m 0755 -- "$path"
    fi
    [ "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' -- "$path")" = 0:0:755 ] || exit 1
done
[ -z "$(findmnt -rn -M "$mountpoint" -o FSTYPE)" ] || {
    echo '3tchedFS mountpoint is already occupied' >&2
    exit 1
}
[ -z "$(find "$mountpoint" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Populate an unaccepted, externally prepared base. Caller owns storage resealing.
set -euo pipefail
fail() { printf 'ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $# == 2 && $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'usage (root): populate.sh BASE_TOPLEVEL PREPARED_ASSETS'

[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$base" -o OPTIONS) == *rw,* ]] || fail 'caller must prepare writable base'
for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
    target=$base/@agent_$member
    [[ -d $target && ! -L $target ]] || fail "missing sibling: $member"
    btrfs subvolume show "$target" >/dev/null
    [[ -z $(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit) ]] || fail "refusing nonempty sibling: $member"
    [[ -d $assets/$member && ! -L $assets/$member ]] || fail "missing assets: $member"
    [[ -z $(find "$assets/$member" -type l -print -quit) ]] || fail 'asset symlinks must be authored explicitly'
    [[ -d $base/@/agent/$member && ! -L $base/@/agent/$member ]] || fail 'unsafe guest mountpoint'
    [[ -z $(find "$base/@/agent/$member" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit) ]] || fail 'guest mountpoint must remain empty'
done
for entry in AGENTS.md SOUL.md USER.md MEMORY.md; do
    [[ ! -e $base/@/agent/$entry && ! -L $base/@/agent/$entry ]] || fail "existing guest entry: $entry"
done

if [[ -e $base/@/etc/3tched ]]; then
    [[ -d $base/@/etc/3tched && -z $(find "$base/@/etc/3tched" -mindepth 1 -print -quit) ]] || fail 'host-folder mountpoint must be empty'

    chown -R root:root "$base/@agent_$member"
    find "$base/@agent_$member" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
    find "$base/@agent_$member" -type f -exec chmod 0644 {} +
    diff -qr "$assets/$member" "$base/@agent_$member"
done
chmod 0700 "$base/@agent_memory" "$base/@agent_rules" "$base/@agent_user"
chmod 0700 "$base/@agent_rules/rules" "$base/@agent_user/user"
chmod 0600 "$base/@agent_rules/rules/rules.md" "$base/@agent_user/user/user.md"
install -d -m 0700 "$base/@agent_user/identity"
for method in memory_store memory_recall memory_retrieve memory_query memory_delete memory_list_namespaces memory_semantic_query; do
    ln -s "/run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/cognitive/operations/$method" "$base/@agent_memory/$method"
done
ln -s rules/AGENTS.md "$base/@/agent/AGENTS.md"
ln -s soul/SOUL.md "$base/@/agent/SOUL.md"
ln -s user/USER.md "$base/@/agent/USER.md"
ln -s memory/MEMORY.md "$base/@/agent/MEMORY.md"
ln -s /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/cognitive "$base/@agent_shared/cognitive"
ln -s /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/agent_config "$base/@agent_shared/agent-config"
ln -s /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/threetched "$base/@agent_shared/threetched-plugins"
ln -s /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/tched_router "$base/@agent_skills/runtime"
ln -s /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/threetched "$base/@agent_skills/skills"
install -d -m 0755 "$base/@/etc/3tched"
for member in skills rules user shared soul memory; do
    ln -s "/etc/3tched/$member" "$base/@agent_$member/host"
done
manifest=$base/@/usr/share/op-dbus/agents/workspace
install -d -m 0755 "$manifest"
(
    cd "$base"
    find @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user -type f -print0 |
        sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum
) > "$manifest/SHA256SUMS"
printf '%s\n' 'Shared templates only. No identity database or private data initialized. Runtime loading requires explicit integration.' > "$manifest/README"
sync -f "$base"
printf 'Populated six agent siblings; kept guest mountpoints empty and authored workspace links.\n'

# Shared workspace image metadata

`op-identity-image` records and checks the immutable base used to seed the
seven shared-partition sibling subvolumes. It does not mount or format a
device, alter Btrfs seeding state, copy a root tree, create a subvolume, or
assign container identity. Device preparation, extraction, sealing, and sprout
creation belong to the external provisioning workflow.

The metadata lives at `@/usr/share/op-dbus/image`. `prepare TOP RELEASE_ID
PROVENANCE_JSON` is intended only for an externally prepared, unsealed base
mounted read-write at its Btrfs top level. It requires host root, refuses an
existing metadata target, and does not adopt or delete prior contents. It also
ensures ordinary root-owned mode-0755 directories at `@/run/mount/3tchedfs`
and `@/run/opdbus/lungs`, refusing symlink or non-directory components while
retaining contents of existing directories. The provenance JSON must contain
exactly these fields:

```json
{
  "archive_name": "ubuntu-26.04-server-cloudimg-amd64-root.tar.xz",
  "archive_sha256": "<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>",
  "archive_url": "https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/resolute/release-20260927/ubuntu-26.04-server-cloudimg-amd64-root.tar.xz",
  "checksum_url": "https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/resolute/release-20260927/SHA256SUMS",
  "signature_url": "https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/resolute/release-20260927/SHA256SUMS.gpg",
  "signer_primary_fingerprint": "D2EB44626FDDC30B513D5BB71A5D6C4C7DB87C81",
  "verified_at_utc": "2026-10-05T00:00:00Z"
}
```

The caller is responsible for downloading and verifying those artifacts before
calling `prepare`. The helper records the downloaded archive's provenance;
it does not claim to perform the signature or archive verification itself.

Before metadata preparation, `prepare-lungs-client TOP READ_ONLY_RELEASE`
installs the release's `3tched-fs` client and two public schema-only views in
the already writable offline base. Both mounts run that same binary, as two
separately supervised processes. It requires a root-controlled read-only
release under `/opt/op-dbus/releases` or `/opt/op-dbus/release-send` and reads
the catalog at `usr/share/op-dbus/plugin-blobs`. The receipt distinguishes a
retained received release from a native source snapshot; a source snapshot is
not evidence of receipt or activation. It refuses existing client/view targets and never
captures live SHM or credentials. The enabled `3tchedfs.service` and
`threetchedfs.service` mount `/run/mount/3tchedfs` and `/run/mount/threetched`:

```fstab
3tchedFS /run/mount/3tchedfs fuse.3tchedFS noauto,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,noatime 0 0
threetched /run/mount/threetched fuse.3tchedFS noauto,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,noatime 0 0
```

`noauto` prevents competing early-boot mounts; each enabled service starts
after local filesystems and tmpfiles. `/usr/sbin/mount.fuse.3tchedFS` runs the
existing preflight and foreground client under service supervision. Manual
mounts also stay in the foreground. Unsupported mount options are rejected
rather than silently ignored. The main view excludes `threetched,tched_router`;
the upstream view includes them, matching the host adapter. Both retain the
same sealed catalog pin and use `/run/3tched-lungs.socket` for canonical writes.
The stores contain immutable declarations, not separate authoritative state.
The offline empty-state directory does not provide live SHM data-file reads.
Runtime prerequisites remain `/dev/fuse`, the lungs socket, sealed catalog,
schema-only views and empty state directory. Offline configuration checks do
not prove an identity-bound operation or a successful boot.

Host agents use a separate projection of the same blobs; no copied schema or
synchronization layer is required. A guest may also serve its MCP clients with:

```sh
3tched-fs --store /usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-view mcp \
  --state /usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-empty-state \
  --lungs-socket /run/3tched-lungs.socket --all
```

Omitting `--lungs-session` selects `BindCurrentContainer`; the bridge derives
the caller from its kernel peer process and the committed native container.
The socket accepts connections with mode `0666` beneath a root-owned `0755`
directory. Connection permission conveys no plugin authority: binding and
every operation revalidate the native identity and existing grants. Explicit
session binding is restricted to root in the bridge's host namespaces.

Incus shares only the host's dedicated `/run/opdbus/lungs` directory, read-only,
at the same guest path. The installed tmpfiles rule `3tched-lungs.conf` creates
the guest-local `/run/3tched-lungs.socket` entrypoint pointing to
`/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock` after `/run` is mounted. The public entrypoint is
not a second listener. Directory binding keeps socket replacement visible
after a bridge restart; binding the socket inode alone does not. Never bind
the host's entire `/run` to provide the public entrypoint.

Owner correction (2026-10-19): retain the sole `:8090` door. Do not add a
separate internet-proxy socket attachment to the seed/profile as a workaround.
`nmrs` is a NetworkManager D-Bus client, not a replacement networking daemon.
Installed NetworkManager or a configured FUSE mount alone does not prove
internet connectivity through that door.

For a headless seed, keep display-manager packages installed but mask the
installed display-manager unit and `display-manager.service`, and select
`multi-user.target` as the default. A network manager's enablement must follow
the actual selected adapter's dependencies, not a similarly named project's
documentation. Verify the existing single-door transport rather than adding a
separate egress socket; a D-Bus socket alone does not establish internet access.

`verify TOP` is the pre-seal check. It validates the exact seven Btrfs sibling
names and mount layout, metadata schema and artifact hashes, the complete
offline dpkg installed-package inventory, hashes and symlink targets for the
critical OS/init files, and neutral machine identity defaults. It reads the
target tree as files and never runs binaries from it. The package component
table marks each selected component present or missing based on the offline
dpkg database; a missing optional component is reported as missing rather
than inferred from filenames or treated as installed.

`verify-metadata TOP` is for later checks of a writable sprout. It validates
the metadata schema, pinned layout, and all metadata artifact hashes, then
prints a stable one-line JSON receipt containing `schema_version`,
`release_id`, `layout`, and `manifest_sha256`. It deliberately does not compare
installed package versions, critical OS files, hostname, machine ID, or
per-leaf contents, so ordinary guest updates and identity changes do not
invalidate the base metadata receipt. The caller should pin these exact fields
in its provisioning receipt and compare them on subsequent checks.

`inspect TOP` performs full verification and prints the manifest. The
manifest's critical hash inventory is deliberately limited to `/etc/os-release`,
`/etc/fstab`, the systemd executable, and `/usr/sbin/init`; it excludes
hostname, machine ID, SSH keys, credentials, agent data, persistence contents,
and runtime state. `@agent_user/persist` is an ordinary directory, not another
subvolume. The guest-owned `/run/mount/3tchedfs` FUSE mount and per-boot
private state under `/dev/shm` are runtime mounts, not seed contents. The
`3tched-lungs` Incus profile supplies `/run` as tmpfs and mounts the host's
dedicated `/run/opdbus/lungs` directory read-only at the same guest path.
Socket permissions and per-connection identity authentication remain the
responsibility of the socket service.

The base should remain unchanged while any sprout depends on it. Seed recovery
tools and an external copy of the manifest must remain available outside the
seed so recovery does not depend on mounting the base itself. The helper never
seals or changes the filesystem read-only; the caller owns that lifecycle
transition.

The isolated shell fixture test is `tests/test-op-identity-image.sh`. It uses
ordinary temporary directories and a mocked `btrfs` listing; it does not mount
or modify a filesystem device.

# Shared agent workspace preparation

`populate.sh BASE_TOPLEVEL PREPARED_ASSETS` populates the six empty sibling
subvolumes of an unaccepted base. The assets use the member directories from
`deploy/config/agents/workspace`. It refuses populated destinations and leaves
rootfs `/agent/{memory,rules,shared,skills,soul,user}` mountpoints empty for the
external provisioner. Ordinary `/agent` contains the Markdown entrypoint links.

Each of memory, rules, shared, skills, soul and user also contains `host`, a
directory symlink to `/etc/3tched/<member>`. The host supplies six initially empty
directories under `/etc/3tched`; Incus mounts the parent read-only at the same
guest path. The directories' contents are deferred to the owner. These are
shared code/configuration defaults, not private namespace-memory or identity
records. Existing defaults and private data stay where they are; the links do
not move records or expose a host directory without its Incus mount.

The storage owner must prove there are no dependent leaves before preparing a
writable base and must restore its filesystem, block-device and mount read-only
state afterward. This helper does not mount, snapshot, clone, unseal, reprovision,
start services or change grants.

Memory links target the existing cognitive MCP memory operations in the guest's
identity-bound 3tchedFS mount at `/run/mount/3tchedfs`. Shared owner links expose
cognitive MCP agent operations and agent configuration. Skills link to the
existing tched-router owner; its current sealed interface does not expose native
SkillsService inventory/contents, so a skill projection remains unfinished.
Do not confuse GetTools with effective skill inventory or add a frozen duplicate.

`@agent_user/identity` is the private destination reserved for the matching
human or machine identity sled during provisioning. The shared base deliberately
contains no identity record. The per-session writer and its refresh/revocation
integration are still required; copying the global credential/state projections
would expose other identities and is not supported here.

No runtime is configured to consume the Markdown files by this script. No memory
call, agent execution, identity write or skill lookup is claimed by the file and
checksum checks. Live checks depend on completing correct identity provisioning
and guest-owned FUSE startup. The pinned native router currently uses host workspaces.

content.text:
## Summary

Completed the assigned source/installed-file investigation: **36 manifest entries accounted for, 33 distinct exported contents read completely**, with three identical-hash installed copies mapped to their source counterparts. No commands, tests, provisioning, storage operations, or edits were performed.

The supplied shell chain is **not an integrated, loop-free provisioning implementation**:

1. **Source and installed helpers disagree on storage location and upgrade FSID.** Even the current source is internally inconsistent: `sync-instance-upgrade.sh` still uses the old pool path and upgrade FSID.
2. **The installed base boot service is a different deployment domain.** Staging application helpers does not update `/etc/sv/identity-roots/run`; that installed service still selects the old, single-chatbot path and exits early.
3. **Every implemented storage branch examined requires host loops.** The newer GPT branch wraps both the seed and the per-instance image; the older sprout branch wraps both physical seed and private leaf. Neither meets the latest constraint.
4. **There are additional deterministic contract mismatches:** the binder accepts one FUSE fstab entry, while image preparation installs two; workspace links target the view that explicitly excludes their plugins; installed binding and current synchronization require `volatile.idmap.current` even though never-started preparation can expose only `.next`.
5. **Preparation is not adoption or startup.** The adoption helper publishes a plan and prints an operation path; it does not invoke adoption. The chatbot preparation branch does not start the container. GPT boot restoration also does not start it.
6. **Interrupted stages fail closed, but do not constitute complete resume support.** Important intents are preserved, yet the shell interfaces mostly require manual reconciliation rather than implementing phase-aware recovery.

These findings establish integration defects and requirement conflicts. They do **not** establish which defect was the last encountered runtime failure, nor prove that no supported no-loop implementation exists.

---

## Evidence notation

All paths below refer to supplied exports beneath:

`reports/provisioning-fusion-20261019/`

- **S/** = `evidence/source/`
- **I/** = `evidence/installed/`
- **H/** = `I/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers/`
- **B/** = `I/usr/local/libexec/3tched/`

Thus `S/deploy/scripts/bind-instance-root.sh:158-184` is an exact exported-file citation, not a claim about fresh runtime state.

Full hashes and original paths come from `manifest.json.source_and_installed`; I did not recompute hashes. Some exports differ from their original-file hashes because of redaction.

---

## Architecture and stage ownership

The existing chatbot path is:

```text
existing caller-bound 3tchedFS
  → identity_sled.prepare_container
  → local native-preparation receipt
  → prepare-instance-disk: create / prepare
  → sync-instance-upgrade: pair
  → bind-instance-root
  → prepare-chatbot-adoption
  → identity_sled.provision_container [separate operation]
  → authoritative identity/native/storage adoption [Rust owner]
  → authorized start [separate lifecycle operation]

base identity-roots service
  → select completed boot receipt
  → restore-chatbot-root
  → sync-instance-upgrade boot
  → stopped root restored and synchronized
```

A second, older branch remains in `op-identity-root`:

```text
seed-create → seed-up/check → seed-lungs → explicit boot attestation
```

It uses a writable Btrfs sprout root and host-created FUSE mount, rather than the newer read-only upgrade-over-seed overlay and guest-owned FUSE mounts. These are **different contracts**, not interchangeable recovery routes.

### Owner and receipt at every stage

| Stage | Existing owner/interface | Receipt and what it actually establishes | Missing completion boundary / required modification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Admission | Caller-bound `3tched-fs invoke`; backend `identity_sled` | Mount metadata/session and mount-ID pins; same-handle operation result. Wrapper uses existing operator session, not target identity impersonation. | Preserve this path. No alternate identity, local native-create fallback, grants repair, or bootstrap replay. |
| Native preparation | `identity_sled.prepare_container`, invoked by `provision-workspace-subscriber.sh` | `$pool/.provisioning/$sid.prepare.json`: exact caller/request/operation ID; `$name.incus.json`: returned name/native UUID and native session/key/creation-operation readback. Phase `container-defined`, identity not registered, root not bound, not started. | Existing target must be reconciled using its original creation operation/native UUID. Do not allocate another name or UUID. |
| Storage allocation | Host storage helper `prepare-instance-disk create` | `$name.json`: `disk-create-intent` → `disk-partitioned`; image inode/size/GPT table. | Receipt currently names the instance but does not itself carry the full native/session/creation-operation binding. Carry and verify that binding before storage establishment. Replace prohibited backing mechanism only after supported storage decision. |
| Seed/sprout and replica establishment | `prepare-instance-disk prepare` | `filesystem-prepare-intent` → `root-device-add-intent` → `upgrade-format-intent` → `filesystems-prepared`; root/upgrade FSIDs and attachment paths. | Current implementation creates loops and forbids mounted physical seed. Both conflict with retained requirements. Incomplete intent is not proof of an established member or formatted replica. |
| Initial upgrade receive/pair | `sync-instance-upgrade pair` | `$name.upgrade.json`: `send-intent` → `paired`, source/replica FSIDs, direction and generation. Received UUID and immutable baseline checked; published clone ancestry checked. | Resolve old path/FSID drift; retain mounted-destination proof and immutable common baseline; do not infer pairing from an empty upgrade directory. |
| Root binding | `bind-instance-root.sh` | `$name.incus.json`: `root-bind-intent` → `root-bound`; overlay/view paths, native definition, flags including `guest_fuse_mounted:false`. | Fix fstab contract, map selection and complete live mount proofs before writing completion. Root-bound remains neither adopted nor started. |
| Adoption preparation | `prepare-chatbot-adoption.sh`; read-only `inspect_provision_preflight` | Private `/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-provision-plans/$sid.json`, version 4; plan digest and `provision-args.json`. Includes expected revision, native ETag, seed/member/image/GPT pins. | Publishing the plan is not adoption. Preserve exclusive publication, root-private permissions, revision and digest binding. |
| Authoritative adoption | Existing `identity_sled.provision_container`, with Rust proof/CAS owner outside this assignment | Shell prints operation and exact arguments, but supplies no invocation/completion receipt. | Parent must connect the Rust owner’s final result/CAS/readback to this stage. Do not turn local `identity_registered` flags into authority. |
| Startup | Existing identity lifecycle owner; not the standalone-system branch | No chatbot-start completion receipt is produced by the assigned shell chain. | Extend the existing workflow to request authorized start only after authoritative adoption and root proof. Record requested transition, exact UUID and returned/native power state. Do not reuse `--system` creation as a bypass. |
| Stopped boot restoration/sync | Base `identity-roots` → `restore-chatbot-root` → `sync-instance-upgrade boot` | GPT `.boot.json` must attest `identity_registered:true` and `restore_existing_pair:true`; native/storage pins checked; synchronization publishes `paired` only after restoration. | Base service deployment is separate. GPT branch restores but does not start; explicit boot-start policy/owner integration remains separate. |
| Running service restart | `restore-chatbot-root` | Observes overlay lower paths and read-only mode; exits without receive/rotation. | Preserve no live-lower updates. Extend observation to the full established root/member/device contract instead of treating only overlay type/lower strings as complete health. |
| Failure/cancellation/resume | Local locks/intents plus backend operation identity | Native creation can reconcile the same operation; storage/bind/receive retain incomplete intent and refuse blind repeats. | Implement explicit phase-aware reconciliation inside these existing helpers/owner, not a new orchestrator. Resume must prove actual state and perform only the missing authorized transition. |

Principal citations: subscriber `:39-143,145-189,353-375`; disk helper `:68-188`; sync `:78-151,203-255,280-407`; binder `:45-84,199-284`; adoption `:65-171`; source boot service `:76-180`; restoration `:44-109`.

---

## Source-versus-installed drift ledger

### Exact paths and FSIDs

No approved non-loop allocation inventory or end-to-end primitive proof appears in the assigned files. This is a precise evidence gap, not a general impossibility claim. Do not infer new LVM management, VM conversion, copied roots or seed retirement as its answer.
